title: Appointment Setter for Real Estate Team - Text/SMS Outreach VA
description:
Join a busy real estate team as our full-time Appointment Setter! Your main job is to keep conversations going with people who've reached out via text and turn those chats into booked appointments for our Purchase Manager.



A typical day looks like:

- Working through incoming SMS/text replies and starting friendly conversations with new leads

- Asking smart questions to understand what each lead is looking for

- Scheduling qualified appointments directly onto the Purchase Manager's calendar

- Logging every conversation, status, and next step in our CRM

- Circling back with leads who went quiet so none slip through the cracks



You'll be a great match if you:

- Write clear, natural, friendly English

- Have done text-based lead follow-up or appointment setting before (real estate experience is a bonus)

- Know your way around a CRM and online calendar/scheduling tools

- Stay organized and take initiative without being micromanaged

- Have dependable internet and a quiet workspace

- Can commit to full-time hours (40/week)



The basics:

- Full-time, long-term role

- Rate: $4/hour

- Plenty of room to grow with the team



When you apply, share a quick note about your appointment setting or text follow-up experience and why this role fits you. We read every application and value people who pay attention to detail.

title: Conversion & Growth Analyst (CRO · Experimentation · Data)
description:
The short version: We run a high-ticket coaching/education business. People apply, book a call, and enroll. Your job is to make more of that happen — by testing relentlessly, reading the data honestly, and owning the systems that turn applications into enrollments. One person, accountable for the whole conversion engine.



What you'll own



Experimentation: design, build, and run split tests in PostHog — real hypotheses, clean setup, honest reads. Not "change the button color" — tests that move enrollment.



The funnel site: 

- Manage and edit our WordPress landing pages and funnel (Be comfortable in WordPress and can ship changes without breaking things).



- Data analysis: own the numbers end-to-end — enrollment rates by source, coach performance, call outcomes, funnel drop-off.  - Turn messy data into decisions. (We lean on AI tools heavily now — you should too.)

- The predictor model: we score every applicant's likelihood to enroll based on 6 qualification questions, calibrated on thousands of applications. You'll maintain it, recalibrate it quarterly, and improve it over time.

- The plumbing: keep the stack talking — ActiveCampaign, 
 automations, EverWebinar, OnceHub scheduling, forms.



Your first 90 days:



- Weeks 1–2: absorb the current experiments, dashboards, site, and the predictor model. Break nothing.

- Weeks 3–6: run your first 2–3 tests solo; own the weekly analytics.

- By day 90: you own the full conversion engine and have run one predictor recalibration.



You must have:



- Real CRO/experimentation experience — you can talk me through a test you ran, the hypothesis, and what the data actually said (including tests that failed).

- Strong data chops — spreadsheets/SQL, and enough statistical literacy to own a scoring model without hand-waving.

- Comfort in WordPress and no-code automation (
/Zapier).

- You're self-directed and consistent — this role rewards people who get better month over month, not people who start strong and coast.



Bonus points:



- Experience with high-ticket / application-funnel or coaching businesses.

- PostHog specifically; ActiveCampaign; EverWebinar/OnceHub.

- You use AI tools to move 3× faster and can show me how.





How to apply — read this carefully (it's part of the test):

- A 3-minute Loom: walk me through one CRO test you ran end-to-end — hypothesis, setup, result, what you'd do next.

- One sentence: the last thing you learned from data that surprised you.

- Use the word "enrollment" in your first line so I know you read this.

- Shortlisted candidates get a paid trial task on our real funnel before any offer. No trial, no hire.

title: Looking for a Marketing Partner to Help Grow a Business Outreach Platform
description:
I’m looking for a talented marketing and sales person, or a small team, to help me grow a business outreach platform with serious potential.



I am not looking to hire a huge sales department or have hundreds of random people promoting the same product.



I want to find the right person or small team, give them a real opportunity, and grow together long term.



I own and operate a couple of businesses, but right now I am still handling almost everything myself. I am building the product, improving it, supporting customers, marketing it, and trying to generate sales.



I am only one person, and I need help taking ownership of the marketing, outreach, and customer growth side.



The Product



The platform is called Group Blast.



You can view it, download it, and try it free here:







Group Blast helps businesses reach more potential customers through
 groups without manually copying and pasting the same post over and over.



A user can create one
 post in a couple of minutes, select 20, 30, or 40 relevant groups, and schedule the campaign to publish automatically throughout the day or week.



Instead of spending hours manually posting in every group, the entire campaign can be created, organized, and managed from one platform.



Group Blast also includes:



• AI-assisted post creation

• Multiple post variations

• Campaign scheduling and organization

• Tools for managing multiple businesses

• Agency features for managing different clients

• The ability to give clients access to their own campaigns



The platform is already published, already has active users, and is ready to sell.



The Full Autopilot Outreach System



I am also completing the next major version of the platform.



This is much more than a posting tool.



The full autopilot version is designed to operate like a trained, full-time
 outreach employee.



After the onboarding and training process, it can continuously scan
 for relevant opportunities, identify potential customers, begin conversations, respond to replies, answer questions, follow up, and move interested people toward booking or purchasing.



It is not just scheduling posts.



It is designed to actively perform outreach and continue conversations automatically with multiple potential customers at the same time.



The goal is for a business to train the system around its offer, communication style, services, ideal customers, and sales process. Once properly trained, it can continue working in the background without the owner manually handling every interaction.



The onboarding takes approximately one week because the system needs to be customized and humanized for each business.



The pricing for the full autopilot system will be:



$1,397 setup



$697 per month after setup



The setup includes the onboarding, customization, training, and development required to make the outreach system communicate naturally for that specific business.



I genuinely believe this is one of the most advanced
 outreach systems being built, and it creates a completely different sales opportunity than another basic social media scheduling product.



The standard Group Blast platform is already live and ready to use now. The full autopilot system is the next major release and is currently being finalized.



Who I Am Looking For



I need someone who can look at this platform and immediately begin seeing opportunities.



You may have experience with:



• Social media marketing

•
 marketing

• Direct outreach

• Business-to-business sales

• Affiliate or commission-based sales

• Building online communities

• Creating marketing campaigns

• Selling products or services to small businesses

• Developing offers and sales strategies



I do not expect you to understand everything immediately.



I care more about finding someone who is creative, dependable, motivated, willing to test different strategies, and interested in learning the product deeply.



You will receive full access to Group Blast.



You can download it, test it, use the free trial, and even use the platform as part of the campaign to help market Group Blast itself.



Compensation



This opportunity will include a smaller upfront payment to begin working together.



You will also earn:



• 30% recurring commission for every customer you bring in after they remain a paying customer for 30 days

• Continued monthly commission while the customers you brought in remain subscribed

• An additional $100 bonus for every 10 customers you bring in who stay active for at least one month



This is not only a one-time sales commission.



Because Group Blast operates on monthly subscriptions, you can build recurring monthly income as the customer base grows.



The full autopilot system also creates the opportunity to sell a higher-value service with a $1,397 setup fee and $697 monthly subscription.



I am not trying to spend a huge amount of money hiring a large agency before we have proven the campaign together.



I am looking for someone who wants to start reasonably, demonstrate what they can do, and grow their income and position as the platform grows.



I am also not the type of business owner who constantly hires and fires people.



I would rather find the right person or small team, build trust, and continue growing together.



How to Apply



Please do not send me a generic copy-and-paste application.



First, visit:







Look through the website, download the platform, and use the free trial if you would like to understand it properly.



Then tell me:



Who you would market Group Blast to first

How you would get the first 25 paying customers

What marketing or sales experience you have

Whether you would be working individually or with a small team

Why you believe you are the right person to help grow this platform



I have complete confidence in the product.



I know many people believe their own product is great, but I have spent a serious amount of time building something that directly helps businesses reach customers, generate conversations, and make more money.



I am looking for a marketer, salesperson, or small team who sees the potential and wants to build something valuable together.

title: Senior Full-Charge Bookkeeper (QuickBooks Online), Job Costing and Financial Statements, US Companies
description:
ABOUT THE ROLE



We are two related US companies based in Hawaii, one in landscaping and one in construction. We are hiring one highly experienced, full-charge bookkeeper to own our books in QuickBooks Online across both companies and to produce our monthly financial statements, working directly with the owner. This is a senior, long-term, full-time role for a seasoned professional who is strong in job costing and comfortable owning the numbers end to end. It is also a hands-on role: you will do the daily data entry yourself, including entering receipts and coding each one to the correct job, quickly and accurately.



WHAT YOU WILL DO



Own accurate job costing and class or location tracking across both companies, so that profit and loss by job and by division is reliable.

Prepare our monthly financial statements: profit and loss, balance sheet, and cash flow, with a short variance summary for the owner.

Run a clean month-end close on both company files: reconcile every bank and credit-card account, book accruals and adjusting entries, and hit a set close date.

Enter receipts and vendor bills promptly and accurately, coding each line to the correct job (job costing) and class, and keeping up with the volume so nothing piles up.

Categorize and code bank and credit-card transactions with correct job and class coding.

Support weekly payroll booking from a payroll-provider export. We will train you on our exact process, and written SOPs exist.

Reconcile our field-service and construction project software to QuickBooks and clear sync errors.

Track accounts receivable and accounts payable and give the owner a weekly status.

Maintain 1099 vendor tracking and prepare tax support schedules for our CPA to file.

Keep our books clean and defensible enough to pass a CPA review and a contractor licensing review.



WHO WE ARE LOOKING FOR (REQUIRED)



5 or more years of hands-on, full-charge QuickBooks Online bookkeeping for US-based businesses.

Deep, hands-on job-costing experience (construction, contractors, field service, or project-based work) with class or location tracking. This is essential, not a nice-to-have.

Fast and accurate with hands-on data entry: you can process a high volume of receipts and vendor bills and still code every one to the right job.

You can independently run a full month-end close and prepare financial statements (profit and loss, balance sheet, and cash flow), and explain the numbers to the owner in plain terms.

Strong command of US accrual accounting, bank and credit-card reconciliations, AR, AP, and the general ledger.

Excellent written English and clear, proactive communication.

Reliability and discretion. You will handle confidential financial information and sign an NDA.



NICE TO HAVE (BONUS)



QuickBooks Online ProAdvisor certification.

Experience with Jobber, JobTread, or similar field-service or construction platforms.

Experience with a US PEO or payroll provider (for example ADP, Gusto, or a Hawaii PEO).

Experience preparing books and financial statements for a CPA year-end, a lender, or a licensing review.



TOOLS YOU WILL USE



QuickBooks Online, Google Workspace (Sheets, Docs, Gmail), Slack, and our field software (Jobber and JobTread). We will train the specifics.



SCHEDULE AND PAY



We are on Hawaii time (HST). Your Manila mornings overlap our afternoons. We will set a small fixed daily overlap window for questions, and most of the work is asynchronous.

Pay is negotiable and based on your experience, paid on time every week.

Long-term role with room to grow as we systematize, plus long-term perks for the right person.





HOW TO APPLY (PLEASE READ CAREFULLY)



We filter for attention to detail. Applications that skip these steps will not be reviewed.





Start your reply with the word "Kalo" so we know you read this.

In 4 to 6 sentences, describe a month-end close you personally own or have owned: how many accounts, what software, how you handle receipt entry and job costing, and how you catch errors.

State your total years of full-charge QuickBooks Online experience, whether you are ProAdvisor certified, your job-costing experience, and whether you prepare financial statements yourself.

State your available hours in HST and your monthly rate expectation in USD.





We review every complete application and reply to strong fits within a few days.

- Collect and store tax-related and performance-related documentation (e.g. holding, distribution, loan, rental, annual, market value, tax statements).

- Maintain and enforce the standard client folder structure, file naming conventions, and financial year categorisation so that files are audit-ready at all times.

- Own the client Fact Find end-to-end — keeping it current after every meeting, statement, or client communication, and ensuring it underpins all advice documents as an auditable chain of evidence.

- Monitor and update the real-time client balance sheet, sourcing data from various platforms and reconciling across systems quarterly.

- Ensure adviser access and login credentials are in place and securely managed across all relevant platforms.

- Collaborate with the PSM to standardise and streamline information management.

- Mindset: “Would I be confident this is clean and client-ready at any time?”



2. The Delivery Project Manager

- Leader of accurate client service implementation and delivery timelines.

- Ensure investment transactions are implemented same-day and insurance applications are begun within 48 hours of approval.

- Turn meeting actions and strategic goals into clearly written, trackable tasks — nothing falls through the cracks.

- Own timelines and deadlines — chasing overdue tasks, flagging bottlenecks, and ensuring every task reaches a clear resolution.

- Delegate technical or administrative tasks appropriately while owning the outcome.

- Coordinate closely with paraplanners, the Practice Support Manager, the Principal Adviser, and external professionals.

- Ensure documents and forms are completed correctly, on time, and sent to the right parties.

- Mindset: “What’s needed to move this forward without needing Principal involvement?”



3. The Relationship Anchor

- Point of continuity, context, and connection for each client.

- Understand the needs and preferences of your clients and orchestrate effective service delivery accordingly.

- Be the primary internal advocate and coordinator for your clients.

- Track developments in the client’s personal and financial life.

- Stay across all meeting notes and ensure task systems reflect meetings.

- Notice changes in goals, mindset, or relationships and raise them with the Principal.

- Support the Principal by ensuring they are well-informed before every meeting.

- Ensure the client never has to repeat themselves or chase us for updates.

- Mindset: “What’s shifted for the client that we haven’t yet actioned?”



4. The Compliant Storyteller

- Ensuring each client file tells a compelling and compliant story.

- Keep client files audit-ready with consistent, clear, and updated notes.

- Manage the full post-meeting workflow: consent and transcription, file note generation and review, follow-up
s, and updating the Fact Find with any new information.

- Ensure fact finds, SOAs, ROAs, and client communications are accurate and well-organised.

- Maintain clarity in the chronology and context of advice decisions.

- Highlight progress and transformation in the client’s journey, tying actions back to their goals.

- Ensure documentation not only meets compliance and privacy standards but tells the narrative of value delivered.

- Mindset: “Would this file make sense to an outsider, showing a clear and compliant story of impact?”



PRIORITISATION ORDER

- From a business perspective, your tasks should be prioritised in the following order:

- Cash / investment transacting, including opening of associated accounts and completion of any KYC / onboarding requirements with third parties where this would delay a cash / investment transaction.

- Insurance applications and getting policies into force.

- Preparing meeting summaries and post-meeting
s for your clients, and any sub-10-minute tasks that are directly requested of you by the Principal Adviser.

- Responding to requests made of us by other professionals (we expect fast responses from them and should return the favour).

- Other work pertaining to clients who are in their first 6 weeks with us (including onboarding).

- Other work pertaining to your broader client list, prioritised by the annual fee that they are paying us and any relationship considerations (including preparing their reports / maintaining their client file with current information / supporting loan applications / etc).

- Balance this priority list with approaching deadlines — as deadlines near, the work becomes a higher priority.

- Anything you can’t get to in a reasonable time, just flag it, and we can try to delegate to others or make a business decision to defer that task.



REPORTING & COLLABORATION

Reports to: Practice Support Manager (PSM) for delivery oversight; Principal Adviser for client outcomes.

Collaborates with: PSM, Paraplanner, Admin Assistant, Principal Adviser.



Indicators of Success

- 100% of clients have complete, current documentation and adviser access.

- Tasks are delivered on time with minimal Principal intervention.

- High service ratings and positive feedback from assigned clients.

- Accurate and timely handoff of technical and administrative work.

- Adviser’s administrative workload is reduced for each client in your portfolio.

- Investment transactions executed same-day; insurance applications commenced within 48 hours.

- Demonstrated proficiency across all required platforms.



Expected Behaviour

- Proactive, reliable, and accountable.

- Thoughtful and detail-oriented.

- Able to prioritise and escalate as needed.

- Collaborative, not siloed.

- Focused on both client satisfaction and internal efficiency.



APPLICATION PROCESS

To apply, please submit the following:

• A 2–5 minute video introducing yourself and explaining why you are the best fit for this role

• Your updated CV and LinkedIn profile link

• Names and contact details of three references (2 professional + 1 personal)



Please apply and
 all details to: 

ONLY those who follow the instructions in how to apply will be accommodated.

Everything should already be configured and organized with minimal setup required on my end.

title: Track and Trace Assistant
description:
GH Logistics is a high performance freight brokerage and asset based logistics company specializing in dry van and reefer freight. We move quickly, but we move with structure. Our operation is built on real time visibility, disciplined execution, and clear communication. We take pride in keeping freight organized, on track, and moving cleanly from pickup to delivery. If you’re someone who enjoys staying engaged, solving live challenges, and being part of a fast moving operations team, you’ll feel right at home here.



Role Overview

As a Track & Trace Assistant, you serve as part of the operational backbone, ensuring shipments are accurately monitored, risks are identified early, and critical information reaches the right people at the right time. if you thrive behind the scenes keeping operations running smoothly, this role is an excellent fit.

• Updating assigned sections of the Tracking Dashboard with accurate ETAs, locations, mileage, and notes

• Communicating with carriers via
 and internal channels to gather updates or resolve missing information

• Monitoring multiple communication channels to prevent missed updates

• Proactively flagging delays, risks, and irregularities, and escalating when necessary

• Coordinating with the Booking Team to confirm ETAs for time sensitive shipments

• Ensuring clean shift handoffs through verbal (Zoom) and written updates

• Follows instructions consistently and executes with precision

• Team oriented, coachable, and open to feedback without ego

• Minimum of 45 words per minute



What Success Looks Like

• Assigned tracking sections are consistently accurate and up to date

• Scheduled updates are sent on time

• Critical shipments are monitored closely and handled with urgency from start to finish

• Carrier tracking and acceptance issues are caught early

• Issues are communicated clearly, both verbally and in writing

• Shift handoffs are smooth, complete, and well documented



Who We’re Looking For

• Has experience in US logistics, freight brokerage, or track & trace

• Familiar with US geography and US logistics trucking operations (a plus)

• Highly organized and comfortable working with multiple spreadsheets, dashboards, and group chats

• Understands urgency and prioritization in a live freight environment

• Communicates clearly and professionally via chat and

• Can monitor multiple shipments at once without losing accuracy

• Pays strong attention to detail and uses sound judgment when issues arise

• Follows instructions consistently and values clean processes

• Works well with a team and is open to feedback and coaching. Collaborates without resistance or ego



Why Join GH Logistics?

• Independent Contractor Setup

• $75 monthly insurance stipend (eligibility begins 30 days after hire)

• Structured systems and clear expectations

• Hands on leadership and direct feedback

• Defined KPIs and measurable growth

• Opportunity to grow within a scaling freight brokerage

• Performance based advancement



Schedule & Work Setup

• Full Time Remote Role| Direct Hire to US Company

• Current Shift Availability: Friday - Tuesday 8 PM - 6 AM  CDT

• Other shifts (only if assigned): 7 AM - 5 PM CDT | 11 PM - 9 AM CDT

• Zoom presence (with camera open) required

• Time tracking software used for accountability and performance support



This role is built for someone who genuinely enjoys following freight in motion, monitoring shipments, confirming updates, and making sure deliveries stay on track. If you like staying proactive, spotting risks before they become problems, and keeping operations running smoothly behind the scenes, you’ll fit right in.

Hi there! We are looking for a proactive, organized, and AI-savvy General Virtual Assistant to support a growing boutique law firm.



The firm works with entrepreneurs, business owners, and growing brands on trademark, contract, business, and entity formation matters. The business is intentionally streamlined, with a strong focus on excellent client service, branding, efficient systems, and long-term growth.



This is a varied role that combines administrative support, legal operations, Notion system management, AI and automation, marketing coordination, content support, and CRM management.

title: Guest Experience & Operations Specialist
description:
About the Company



Luxury Lodging is a fast-growing short-term rental property management company overseeing 300+ homes across the United States. Our team is performance-driven and focused on delivering exceptional guest experiences while maximizing owner satisfaction. We manage day-to-day operations including guest relations, maintenance, pricing, onboarding, and owner success.



This is not a short-term or temporary role. We are looking for someone who wants to build a long-term career with us. The ideal candidate is dependable, proactive, calm under pressure, and takes ownership of problems until they're fully resolved.



If you're actively job hopping or simply looking for your next temporary position, this role is probably not the right fit. We're investing in someone who wants to grow alongside the company.



---



About the Role



Position: Guest Experience & Operations Specialist

Location: Remote

Pay: $7.5/hour

Type: Full-Time (Eastern Time) 40hrs/week



Guest reviews are one of the most important drivers of our success. Your primary responsibility will be ensuring every guest has an exceptional stay and helping us maintain portfolio ratings above 4.85 stars.



Unlike a traditional customer support role, you'll proactively reach out to guests throughout their stay, not just respond when they contact us. You'll identify potential issues before they become negative reviews, coordinate resolutions, negotiate appropriate compensation when necessary, and work with internal teams, vendors, and property owners to deliver the best possible outcome.



This role requires someone who can think critically, make sound decisions, and remain composed during challenging situations.



---



What You'll Be Doing:

* Proactively call guests throughout their stay to ensure they're having a 5-star experience

* Identify guest concerns before they become complaints or negative reviews

* Build rapport with guests while creating memorable hospitality experiences

* Resolve guest issues using sound judgment, empathy, and strong communication

* Develop creative recovery strategies to turn unhappy guests into satisfied ones

* Negotiate refunds, credits, discounts, or other service recovery solutions when appropriate

* Balance guest satisfaction, company policies, operational limitations, and business costs

* Coordinate directly with maintenance staff, cleaners, contractors, and vendors to resolve reported issues quickly

* Communicate with property owners to obtain approvals for repairs, refunds, or special accommodations when needed

* Follow every issue through completion while keeping all parties informed

* Monitor ongoing stays and prioritize high-risk reservations that may impact reviews

* Ensure listing information remains accurate and up to date across all platforms

* Document guest interactions, resolutions, and operational notes thoroughly

* Identify recurring operational issues and recommend improvements

* Complete administrative tasks, reporting, and documentation

* Take on additional responsibilities as the company continues to grow



---



What We're Looking For:

* Excellent spoken and written English

* Comfortable speaking on the phone for a significant portion of the workday

* Naturally empathetic and able to build trust quickly

* Strong negotiation and conflict-resolution skills

* Calm under pressure and able to think clearly during difficult situations

* Excellent critical thinking and decision-making abilities

* High level of ownership and accountability

* Exceptional organization and follow-through

* Comfortable juggling multiple active guest cases simultaneously

* Strong multitasking skills without sacrificing attention to detail

* Tech-savvy and comfortable learning multiple software platforms

* Hospitality, Airbnb, hotel, customer success, or guest relations experience is a strong advantage

* Experience coordinating vendors or maintenance is a plus

* Looking for long-term career growth



---



The Ideal Candidate

You're someone who genuinely enjoys helping people while also understanding the business side of hospitality.

You don't simply apologize—you solve problems.

You don't wait for issues to escalate—you prevent them.

title: Experienced Video Editor & Motion Graphics
description:
*** Please read through the entire post before applying. Thanks! ***



# Technical and Creative Video Editor



## Part-Time Remote Role



### Company Description



We are a Sydney-based video production company creating exciting video content for food, beverage, hospitality, lifestyle and travel brands.



We work with established Australian and global brands to create engaging content and bring their ideas to life through expert video production. Our work ranges from larger commercial campaigns and brand films to social media reels, recipe videos and campaign cutdowns.



We are a small but growing company, and we put a great deal of care into every project. We want to deliver videos that we are proud of and that achieve our clients’ goals.



We are looking for a creative, enthusiastic and detail-oriented video editor who is interested in developing a long-term role with the company.



## The Three Pillars of Success



To succeed in this role, you must embody these three core values:



**Discipline:** You have the self-discipline to manage your time, meet deadlines and work without constant supervision. You carefully read each brief, follow instructions and pay close attention to detail.



**Passion:** You are passionate about video editing and bring enthusiasm to your work. You want to continually improve your craft, learn new techniques and find creative ways to make each video stronger.



**Honesty:** You communicate openly, take responsibility for your work and raise problems early. You are a team player who wants to contribute to the overall success of the company.



## Role Overview



We are looking for a capable mid-level video editor to work across a variety of commercial and social media projects.



Our projects include:



* Food and recipe videos

* Hotel and hospitality content

* Tourism films

* Interview-led brand stories

* Commercial campaigns

* Instagram and TikTok reels

* Vertical and horizontal campaign cutdowns



Projects will range from straightforward short-form social edits to polished two-minute campaign videos involving more advanced storytelling, sound editing and colour grading.



The motion graphics component is secondary to the editing role. However, you must be comfortable creating and animating basic text, titles, captions and other simple graphic elements.



We value clean and intentional editing, strong visual storytelling, considered music choices and attention to detail. This is not primarily a high-volume, template-based editing role.



## Editing Style and Reference Videos



Our work is visually polished, cinematic and story-led, while still being designed for modern social platforms.



We value strong footage selection, natural pacing, thoughtful music choices, detailed sound design and clean colour grading.



Please watch all three reference videos before applying. They demonstrate the general style, quality and range of editing required for this role.



**Social campaign:**





**Short-form social media video:**





**Longer-form campaign video:**





The successful applicant should be comfortable working towards this level of polish across both short-form social content and longer campaign edits.



We are not looking for someone who relies heavily on templates, excessive transitions, constant animated captions or visual effects that distract from the footage. Editing decisions should feel intentional and support the story, footage and brand.



## Core Responsibilities



* Edit assigned projects using supplied footage, creative briefs and reference materials.

* Ingest and organise footage in Adobe Premiere Pro according to our project organisation protocols.

* Sync multicamera footage and separately recorded audio.

* Review footage and identify the strongest performances, 
nts and visual details.

* Build first assemblies and develop them into polished edits.

* Edit interview-led videos using dialogue, music and supporting footage.

* Select appropriate music from approved libraries.

* Balance dialogue, music and sound effects.

* Perform basic dialogue cleanup and sound design.

* Colour-correct and grade professionally shot LOG footage.

* Create simple text animations, captions, titles and motion graphics.

* Prepare accurate captions using Australian English.

* Adapt videos into formats including 16:9, 9:16 and 4:5.

* Complete internal and client feedback rounds carefully and efficiently.

* Work with feedback supplied through platforms such as Dropbox Replay.

* Maintain clear file naming, version control and export organisation.

* Deliver clean, organised and relinkable project files.

* Communicate progress clearly and raise technical problems, missing assets or deadline concerns early.



## Must-Have Technical Skills



**Adobe Premiere Pro:** Strong proficiency is required. Premiere Pro is our primary editing platform, and all project files must be created and delivered in Premiere Pro.



**Adobe After Effects:** Working knowledge is required for titles, text animation and simple motion graphics.



**Colour:** Experience colour-correcting and grading LOG footage to create a consistent and professional result.



**Sound:** Experience cleaning dialogue and balancing voice, music and sound effects.



**Storytelling:** A strong understanding of pacing, music, performance and visual storytelling.



**Portfolio:** A strong portfolio or reel that includes relevant commercial, branded, hospitality, tourism, food or social media work.



**Communication:** Strong written and spoken English, with the ability to understand feedback and ask clear questions when necessary.



**Remote workflow:** Experience working with proxies, relinking media and managing large video projects remotely.



## Technical Requirements



You must have:



* A computer capable of editing professional 4K footage through a proxy workflow.

* Reliable high-speed internet.

* Sufficient local storage for active projects.

* The ability to download and upload large project files.

* Some availability overlapping with Sydney business hours on agreed working days.



This position is for an individual editor. We are not accepting applications from agencies, studios or outsourcing teams.



## Advantageous Experience



The following experience would be beneficial but is not essential:



* Food, hospitality, hotel or tourism content

* Sony FX3 or S-Log3 footage

* Multicamera interview editing

* DaVinci Resolve

* More advanced Adobe After Effects skills

* Dropbox and Dropbox Replay

* Social-first editing for Instagram, TikTok and paid advertising

* Working with professional directors, producers or creative agencies



## Hours and Compensation



* Part-time remote position

* Approximately 20 hours per week

* Starting rate of **US$5.00 to US$8.00 per hour**

* Approximately **US$430 to US$690 per month**, depending on hours worked

* The final starting rate will depend on experience, portfolio quality and demonstrated technical ability

* Opportunities for increased hours and compensation as the role develops

* Performance and compensation review after the first three months



This is a mid-level position. We are looking for someone with solid professional foundations who can complete many projects independently while continuing to develop their creative and technical skills.



## Paid Editing Test



Shortlisted applicants will be invited to complete a more extensive paid editing test.



The test will involve supplied footage, a creative brief and clearly defined deliverables. Applicants will be paid for completing the test.



The test will assess:



* Editing judgement

* Storytelling and pacing

* Footage selection

* Music selection

* Sound editing

* Colour grading

* Attention to detail

* Project organisation

* Ability to interpret and follow a brief

* Ability to respond to feedback



Further instructions about the test will only be provided to shortlisted applicants.



## A Note on AI and Judgement



We use modern tools where they genuinely improve the production process. However, this role requires human creative judgement, attention to detail and honest communication.



Please write your application responses in your own words. We want to hear your genuine thoughts and understand how you naturally communicate.



Client footage, transcripts, unreleased campaigns and confidential materials must never be uploaded to an AI platform or unapproved third-party service.



## How to Apply



To be considered, you must follow the instructions below exactly. The ability to carefully read and follow a brief is an important requirement for this role.



### 1. Application Title



Change the title of your application to:



**Technical and Creative Video Editor – [Your Name]**



Applications that do not use this exact title format will not be considered.



### 2. Portfolio



Provide links to your three best and most relevant examples of video editing work.



At least one example should demonstrate a similar editing style or level of polish to the reference videos included in this job description.



For each example, briefly explain what you personally completed, including whether you were responsible for:



* Editing

* Music selection

* Sound editing

* Colour grading

* Captions

* Motion graphics



Please do not submit a general portfolio without identifying the specific videos you personally edited.



**No relevant portfolio means no consideration.**



### 3. Attention-to-Detail Question



State the **10th word** in the sentence directly underneath the heading:



**“The Three Pillars of Success”**



### 4. Editing Challenge



In exactly **two sentences**, describe a specific occasion when you encountered a complicated editing problem and explain how you overcame it.



Use clear and natural English. Your response must be exactly two sentences.



### 5. Technical Setup



Include the following details:



* Computer model

* Processor

* RAM

* Graphics card

* Available storage

* Internet download speed

* Internet upload speed



### 6. Availability



State:



* Your current availability

* Your preferred working hours

* How many hours you can consistently work each week

* Your expected hourly rate

* Whether you can overlap with Sydney business hours



### 7. CV or Résumé



Attach or link to your CV or résumé.



It must be supplied in PDF format.



### 8. Optional Video Introduction



Applicants who want to stand out may record a 60-second Loom video or similar introducing themselves.



Begin the video by saying:



**“I’m applying for the Technical and Creative Video Editor role.”**



Then explain why your experience and editing style would suit this position.



Applicants who include a thoughtful video introduction will be prioritised during the initial review.



Thank you for your time and genuine interest in the role. We are looking for someone who wants to become a trusted long-ter
mber of the company and grow creatively alongside us.

title: Architectural 3D Modeler
description:
We are looking for a talented Architectural 3D Modeler to join our team as a full-time, long-term contractor. This role is primarily focused on building accurate, production-ready 3D models of modular and manufactured homes, with some architectural rendering work included.



This is a dedicated remote position with steady, ongoing work supporting one of the most exciting digital platforms in the modular and manufactured housing industry.



Our technology allows home buyers to customize their future home online and instantly visualize their selections through a highly realistic interactive configurator.  Your primary responsibility will be turning architectural drawings and CAD files into complete, accurate SketchUp models of modular and manufactured homes.



WHAT YOU’LL DO:

- Read and interpret DWG and DXF architectural files

- Build accurate interior and exterior SketchUp models from CAD drawings

- Model complete homes, including walls, rooflines, windows, doors, porches, dormers, cabinetry, kitchens, bathrooms, and other architectural details

- Create interchangeable options within each model, such as different porches, dormers, cabinets, countertops, flooring, siding, roofing, and interior finishes

- Organize models using consistent groups, components, tags, and naming conventions

- Prepare models for rendering and use within our production workflow

- Make revisions based on architectural drawings and team feedback

- Assist with photorealistic interior and exterior renderings when needed

- Work with layered Photoshop files used by our interactive home configurator



Because these models support hundreds of available home options, accuracy, organization, and consistency are extremely important.



REQUIRED SKILLS:

- Strong SketchUp modeling experience is required

- Experience reading and interpreting DWG and DXF architectural files is required

- Ability to build complete, production-ready residential models from CAD drawings is required

- Strong understanding of residential construction and architectural details

- Experience modeling both residential interiors and exteriors

- Ability to create clean, organized, and efficient SketchUp files

- Understanding of groups, components, tags, scenes, materials, and model optimization

- Photoshop experience for post-processing and working with layered PSD files

- Architectural rendering experience



PREFERRED SOFTWARE EXPERIENCE:

- SketchUp

- D5 Render

- V-Ray

- Lumion

- Twinmotion

- Enscape

- Adobe Photoshop

- Autodesk Revit is a strong plus



WHAT WE’RE LOOKING FOR:

- Someone who enjoys detailed architectural modeling, not only creating attractive renderings

- Strong understanding of residential floor plans, elevations, dimensions, rooflines, and construction details

- Exceptional attention to detail and organizational skills

- Ability to produce consistent work across a large library of home models

- Ability to follow established modeling standards, file structures, and naming conventions

- Ability to identify missing or conflicting information in architectural drawings and ask the right questions

- Someone comfortable working within an existing production pipeline



COMMUNICATION MATTERS:

This is a collaborative role. You must be comfortable communicating clearly in English during video meetings, discussing projects, asking questions, and working closely with our team.  Communication, reliability, and the ability to consistently complete accurate models are just as important as artistic ability.



POSITION DETAILS:

- Full-time contractor

- 40 hours per week

- Fully remote

- Long-term position

- Stable, ongoing work

- 13th-month bonus



TO APPLY PLEASE SEND:

- Examples of complete SketchUp home models you have built

- Examples showing models created from DWG or DXF architectural drawings

- Your portfolio of residential interior and exterior work

- Examples of photorealistic architectural renderings

- Examples of Photoshop post-processing work

- A brief overview of your experience with SketchUp, CAD workflows, residential modeling, rendering software, and Photoshop



Please clearly explain which portfolio examples you personally modeled and which ones you only rendered.



We are looking for someone interested in building a long-term career with our team. We interview for communication, reliability, attention to detail, and team fit just as much as technical ability.

title: Amazon Supplement R&D Lead - Product Research, Formulation & Packaging
description:
We're a US supplement brand selling on Amazon and TikTok Shop. We win by finding niches our competitors miss and executing sharper on research, formulation, and packaging. We're hiring ONE sharp, exclusive, full-time R&D Lead to own our product pipeline end to end - you d
 what we launch next and back it with data.



WHAT YOU'LL OWN

- Niche Analysis & GO/NO-GO reports: for each new product idea, research demand (search volume, category revenue, TikTok signal), barrier to entry (new-entrant revenue, click-share, price bands), the keyword/ranking landscape, a full competitor teardown, a proposed formula, mined customer-review insight, and a clear GO/NO-GO call. This decision-ready analysis is your core output.

- Formulation direction: shape the formula - ingredients, forms, clinical doses, %DV, branded ingredients (KSM-66, chelated minerals, etc.) - benchmarked to top competitors. You hand our formulator a tight brief.

- Packaging strategy & copy: d
 the front-panel hierarchy (headline, subheading, claims, keyword placement, badges) for bottle and box - keyword-optimized AND FDA-compliant (structure/function claims, %DV, Supplement Facts).

- Competitor & market intelligence: track competitor launches and Amazon + TikTok trends; deliver a weekly intel report.



YOU MUST HAVE

- 2+ years hands-on Amazon private-label product research (supplements/health/CPG strongly preferred)

- Helium 10 (or DataDive/SmartScout) + TikTok data (KaloData)

- US supplement label compliance (%DV, structure/function claims, Supplement Facts)

- Enough ingredient/dosing knowledge to build a competitive formula and QC a competitor's label

- Sharp English writing; AI-native (you drive Claude/ChatGPT daily)



HOW WE WORK

Full-time, exclusive, long-term - focused on our brand, not juggling other clients. We use time-tracking and work transparently in shared docs. Integrity and straight communication over raw speed.



PAY & GROWTH

$20/hour full-time to start, with a short paid trial up front and a clear path to $25/hour as you prove out (consistent GO/NO-GO quality + a launched winner). Long-term home for the right person.



HOURS

Full-time (40 hrs/week), daily overlap ~1-5 PM US Eastern.



TO APPLY

Start your message with the word CORTISOL so we know you read this. Include: (1) 1-2 real samples of Amazon/supplement research you've done, (2) your tool stack and what you pull from each, (3) one supplement niche you think is about to pop and why (2-3 sentences). Finalists do a strong interview, then a short skills test + a PAID mock niche analysis.

This role lives inside our marketing engine, working directly with our Director of Marketing across paid ads, long-form YouTube, and eventually organic social.



Please make sure you read the job description in its entirety. There are instructions below on how to complete your application. If you do not follow the steps and send an
 with requested documentation to 
 , your application will not be considered. 



Role Mission

This role exists to take the raw footage we film and cut it into polished, on-brand video that performs. You won't be filming. You'll be editing, and you'll be editing a lot. To start, the work is mostly paid ads built for multiple platforms, plus some long-form YouTube. As we grow, this expands into organic content too. Your job is to make every cut land at our golden standard, fast, with minimal back and forth. If you're a great editor who takes direction well and moves quickly, this is a long-term seat.



Who We Are Looking For



We're looking for a genuinely strong editor, not someone learning on our footage. You probably are:

A fast, precise editor who can match a defined style and hit it consistently.

Fluent in at least one professional editing suite and comfortable picking up others.

A clear spoken English communicator who can take notes and direction without confusion.

Someone who treats a brief seriously and delivers close to right on the first pass.

Reliable, responsive, and able to manage an ongoing workload without hand-holding.

Comfortable with paid ad editing and the pacing that platform content demands.

You probably are not the right fit if you need heavy supervision, miss deadlines, or struggle to communicate clearly in English.



Responsibilities & Expectations

This role reports to and takes direction directly from Autumn, our Director of Marketing.

Paid Ad Editing (Primary, To Start)

Cut paid ad creative from supplied footage for multiple platforms.

Format and resize for each platform's specs and aspect ratios.

Hold our golden standard on pacing, captions, branding, and polish across every deliverable.

Long-Form Editing

Edit long-form YouTube content from supplied footage.

Structure cuts for retention: clean intros, tight pacing, clear payoff.

Organic Content (As We Grow)

Edit short-form organic social content as the role expands beyond ads.

Stay current on format trends so our organic content feels native to each platform.

Workflow & Communication

Take footage, briefs and revision notes from Autumn and turn them around quickly.

Keep communication clear and prompt. Some overlap with US working hours is preferred. Async is workable.



Required Experience & Skills

Must Have (Non-Negotiable)

Proven editing skill with a portfolio or reel that demonstrates it.

Proficiency in at least one professional suite: Premiere Pro, After Effects, CapCut, or DaVinci Resolve.

Clear spoken and written English.

Experience editing for paid ads, organic short-form platform content and long form video.

Reliable internet, hardware, and availability for ongoing full-time work.

Strongly Preferred

Multi-platform formatting experience across paid social.

Motion graphics and basic title or caption design.

Long-form YouTube editing experience.

Experience editing organic short-form content.

Familiarity with health, wellness, or maternal content.



Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

| KPI | Target |

| Turnaround time per ad cut | Within agreed deadline, no chasing |

| Revision rounds per deliverable | Two or fewer |

title: Content Creator / Social Media Manager - AI Powered
description:
Who We Are

We are a growth and performance company (Ignite 5) helping founders and executives scale their businesses and perform at their best - through coaching, AI-powered systems, and done-for-you growth engines. We also operate a connected luxury wellness design and build brand (IWD), creating physical spaces (saunas, cold plunge, cryotherapy, biohacking tech). Same mission across both - helping people build businesses and lives where they can perform at their best.

We are a lean, AI-native team. We move fast, use AI in nearly everything we do, and are looking for someone who operates the same way.



The Role

We need someone to fully own content creation and social media management - not just execute what we hand you, but bring strategy and consistency to make this work end to end. The goal is content that attracts our ideal audience, builds real thought leadership, and drives people to book a call and become a client. Not vanity metrics - real business results. This role has two parts:



Part 1 - Our Own Brand

LinkedIn: Our founder's personal account, 1-3 posts per week to start, likely increasing over time & sharing that content to the Ignite 5 company page

Instagram - full management, feed, stories, reels - on our Our Founder’s account & the IWD account 

YouTube - Our founder’s account - podcasts, turning long-form podcast/video content into shorts and clips

Weekly
 newsletter, tied closely to a bi-weekly LinkedIn newsletter - both repurposing key ideas from our content

Light repost-only management on TikTok and X - no new content creation there, just resharing what exists elsewhere

Coordinating with our video editor to keep content production on schedule



Part 2 - Client Work (White-Label)

As part of our services, we also provide content and social media management for select clients. Our first example is a founder who sold his own company and now advises other business owners on growth and exit planning. The work is similar in nature - building his personal brand on LinkedIn to establish him as a trusted authority in his space, with content built around his story, expertise, and audience. This is a smaller, more contained scope than our own accounts and would be a second stream of work alongside Part 1. At this point, he only has his personal LinkedIn account and shares that content to his company page on LinkedIn.



What Success Looks Like

Growing following, increasing engagement, and content that moves people toward booking a call - whether for us or for our clients. We're not looking for someone who just posts. We're looking for someone who treats this like they own the outcome.

Tools



Heavy use of AI (Claude and similar) for writing and content development is expected - this role cannot be done well without it. Familiarity with tools like Canva, CapCut or Descript for basic editing, and GHL for scheduling and
 delivery is a plus. We also work with outside specialists for AI avatar video production, so this role is about strategy, writing, and management - not necessarily hands-on video editing.



Compensation

We're looking for the right fit and quality of work over a fixed hourly structure. Open to proposals - whether that's a flat monthly rate for a defined scope of deliverables, or another structure that makes sense for both sides.

title: System Administrator & Support Specialist
description:
PFS Global is seeking to hire a remote, tech savvy System Administrator to work for our full-service business management company which is located in California, United States. This is a dual-purpose role focused on modernizing our infrastructure and providing high-level technical support. You will be instrumental in our transition from legacy on-premise setups to a cloud-first architecture. We are looking to fill this position immediately. Please only apply if you meet the below qualifications:



Qualifications:

1 - Must type 55 WPM (you will be tested)

2 - Must have minimum internet speeds of 25/25 mbps (download/upload)

3 - Team player with excellent communication skills in English

4 - Full-time availability at 40 hours / week , Mon - Fri (Pacific Standard Time)



Key Responsibilities:

• Project Work (70%): Infrastructure deployment, Azure management, automation, and cloud migration.

• Support/Help Desk (30%): User troubleshooting, device enrollment, and ticketing via Jira.

• Infrastructure Modernization: Decommissioning on-prem servers and migrating to serverless/cloud environments.

• Device Management: Enrolling workstations, managing user attributes and device policies.

• Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs): Creating clear, step-by-step documentation for common IT tasks (e.g., "How to Reset a Password," "How to Setup OpenVPN").

• AI & Automation: Working alongside me to implement cloud-first and AI-powered automation. We will use AI to generate code, or use it to make decisions in a larger algorithm.

Administrative Support: Assisting the broader admin team with routing phone calls and managing high-priority service requests.



Technical Requirements (The "Must-Haves")

The ideal candidate doesn't need 10 years of experience, but they must have a fundamental, deep understanding of how the internet and networking work. Cloud & Virtualization



• Azure: Managing Virtual Machines, Files, and Microsoft Entra ID.

• Google Workspace: Admin-level management including Gmail, Drive & App Script

• Identity Management: User management in Google Workspace, Microsoft Entra, and Active Directory

• Virtual Desktops: Supporting On-Prem RDS Environments and/or Azure Virtual Desktop Productivity & Automation

• Scripting: Familiarity with automation via scripting languages (Bash, PowerShell, JavaScript, Python, etc.)

• Configuration Management: understanding of config file formats (JSON, YAML, INI, etc.). Also, OS Configuration like environmental variables and “PATH” management.

• Ticketing: Experience with Jira Service Management.



Candidate Persona & Culture Fit

• We want someone who is genuinely curious about technology and spends their free time learning how things work under the hood.

• We value fundamental knowledge and "hunger" over specific years of experience in a single tool.

• Must be able to follow technical flowcharts and documentation to execute complex tasks independently.

• High-proficiency in English (required for system management and global team collaboration).

• You will need to create flowcharts and documentation in English as well, so writing is important.



Monthly Compensation Package: ?51,500 (Inclusive of Basic Hourly Pay, De Minimis Benefits, and Non-Taxable Allowances.) Paid as an Employee through our Philippines Representative Office.



Paid as an Employee through our Philippines Representative Office.



If you meet the above qualifications, and the description above sounds like the position that you are looking for, please apply and forward us your typing (WPM) and internet (upload/download) speeds in order to get an interview.

title: Level Up, Engr! Turn Your EE/ECE/ME Degree into a Global Trade Career with Korea
description:

- DongYang Engineering (DYE) is an engineering-based global trading company located in Ulsan, Korea, with approximately 30 employees.

- DYE provides engineering and procurement services in the shipbuilding, offshore, plant, and wind power industries. We also support sourcing and quotation work for electrical, electronic, and mechanical products by connecting overseas buyers with domestic Korean suppliers.

- In addition, DYE works with global partners such as Schneider Electric and Emerson, supplying our partners’ materials and services to customers in Korea.

- Currently, DYE has a 3-member overseas sales team composed of Korean and Nepalese tea
mbers who are fluent in English. We provide a supportive working environment so that new employees can adapt quickly.

- DYE also plans to expand its overseas sales and global operations team with a focus on Filipino talent. Therefore, this position offers future opportunities to grow into a team leader or management role.



[About the Position]

- We are looking for an Electrical & Electronics Inquiry / Quotation ERP Data Assistant.(Entry~Experienced Level)

- This position is responsible for checking overseas buyer inquiries and supplier quotation information, then accurately entering and managing the data in our company’s ERP program.

- Since the products are related to electrical, electronic, and mechanical fields, the candidate should be able to understand and distinguish basic product names, model numbers, specifications, quantities, unit prices, and quotation terms.

- The ERP input method can be learned by referring to our existing work records accumulated over the past 4 years. Internal tea
mbers will also provide guidance when needed.



[Company Introduction Materials]

- Company Introduction Video:

youtu.be/zCExthh9pzc?si=EkDCs7pqN6WylsWP

- Company
 Page:

www.

[Responsibilities]

- Enter organized information into each required field in the ERP system

- Check and reflect quotation materials received from domestic Korean suppliers

- Refer to existing ERP input records and enter data according to the company’s internal standards

- Confirm unclear product information or specifications with internal tea
mbers

- Manage quotation progress and related data in an organized manner



[Required Qualifications & Skills]

This position requires basic technical understanding because it handles information related to electrical, electronic, and mechanical products.

- Degree or background in Mechanical Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Electronics Engineering, or a related technical field

- Basic understanding of electrical, electronic, or mechanical products

- Ability to distinguish product names, model numbers, specifications, quantities, unit prices, and quotation details

- Ability to carefully check documents, numbers, and technical information

- Basic Microsoft Excel and Word skills

- Ability to read English product inquiries and quotation documents and understand the basic contents

- Willingness to learn ERP programs and internal work systems

- Responsible attitude toward repetitive but important data entry tasks



[Preferred Experience]

The following experience is not mandatory, but it will be helpful for adapting to the role.

- Experience handling quotations, purchase orders, invoices, or product lists

- Experience using ERP, inventory management, purchasing management, or quotation management systems

- Experience in trading, export/import, purchasing, sourcing, or overseas sales support

- Experience communicating with suppliers or organizing supplier quotation data

- Experience reviewing product catalogs, spec sheets, manuals, or technical documents

- Experience with electrical/electronic components, industrial products, or machinery

- Experience organizing data using Excel



[Who We Are Looking For]

For this position, accurate understanding and careful organization are more important than fast typing.

This role is suitable for someone who:

- Handles documents and numbers accurately

- Can follow fixed formats and internal standards

- Does not guess unclear information and asks for confirmation when needed

- Can refer to previous examples and apply the same standards consistently

- Can handle repetitive data entry tasks responsibly

- Has an interest in global trade and technical products

- Wants to grow with a Korea-based global business team

ERP input data may be used for quotation review, supplier communication, and future export decisions, so a responsible work attitude is very important.



[Training & Work Support]

New employees are not expected to handle everything alone from the beginning.

DYE provides the following training and support:

- Existing ERP input records accumulated over the past 4 years

- Educational tutorial videos to help understand the work

- A mentorship program to help new employees adapt quickly

- Guidance from internal tea
mbers

- Additional explanations from a tea
mber who understands the current workflow



[Compensation & Employment Terms]

- This position is open to both entry-level or junior candidates and experienced candidates.

- Candidates with little or no related work experience will receive structured training under a designated mentor to adapt to our internal systems and operational standards.

- Candidates with 3 or more years of practical experience in mechanical engineering, electrical engineering, electronics engineering, trading, sourcing, quotation management, ERP data management, purchasing, export/import, or related fields may apply as experienced candidates.

Candidates with 3 or more years of practical experience in mechanical engineering, electrical engineering, electronics engineering, trading, sourcing, quotation management, ERP data management, purchasing, export/import, or related fields may apply as experienced candidates.

title: Full-Time Senior E-Commerce Bookkeeper & Accountant
description:
Location: Remote

Hours: 40 hours per week

Salary: AUD $2,000 per month

Position: Long-term, full-time role



## About the Role



We are looking for an exceptional, highly experienced e-commerce bookkeeper and accountant to take complete ownership of our day-to-day bookkeeping, reconciliations, inventory accounting and financial reporting.



This is not a basic data-entry bookkeeping position. We need someone who is outstanding with numbers, extremely accurate, commercially minded and capable of turning financial and inventory data into clear, reliable reports that support real business decisions.



You must be highly proficient in Xero and have proven experience working with e-commerce businesses, preferably across multiple Shopify stores, currencies, payment providers and international markets.



The successful applicant will become a trusted member of our business and will be responsible for maintaining clean, accurate and fully reconciled accounts while helping us improve profitability, cash flow, inventory purchasing and financial forecasting.



## Key Responsibilities



### Bookkeeping and Reconciliation



* Maintain complete and accurate bookkeeping records in Xero.

* Reconcile all bank accounts, credit cards, loans and financial accounts.

* Reconcile Shopify Payments, PayPal, Afterpay, Klarna and other payment gateways.

* Match Shopify orders, payouts, refunds, discounts, chargebacks, transaction fees and currency conversions.

* Investigate and resolve reconciliation discrepancies quickly.

* Correctly record supplier bills, expenses, payments, deposits, refunds and credits.

* Manage accounts payable and accounts receivable.

* Track outstanding supplier invoices and upcoming payment obligations.

* Maintain a clean and logical chart of accounts.

* Process accruals, prepayments, journals and balance-sheet adjustments.

* Ensure every transaction has the correct documentation and audit trail.

* Identify duplicate, missing, incorrect or unusual transactions.

* Support payroll bookkeeping and employee expense reporting when required.



### E-Commerce Accounting



* Accurately calculate revenue, discounts, returns, refunds, chargebacks and net sales.

* Separate product revenue, shipping revenue, taxes, duties and other income.

* Record payment-processing fees and marketplace fees correctly.

* Reconcile gross Shopify sales to actual deposits received.

* Manage accounting across multiple Shopify stores and currencies.

* Track foreign exchange gains, losses and conversion fees.

* Assist with consolidating financial results across different stores, entities and markets.

* Calculate accurate cost of goods sold.

* Report gross profit, contribution margin and net profit.

* Analyse profitability by store, market, product, SKU and collection.

* Track advertising costs and calculate performance after COGS, fees, shipping and operating expenses.

* Identify margin problems, excessive costs and financial leakage.

* Maintain accurate records for GST, VAT, sales tax and other applicable taxes.

* Work professionally with external accountants and tax advisers when required.



### Inventory and Stock Reporting



You must understand inventory beyond simply entering purchase invoices.



Your responsibilities will include:



* Maintain accurate inventory values in Xero and supporting systems.

* Track stock on hand, available stock, committed stock, incoming stock and stock in transit.

* Track all open purchase orders and supplier deposits.

* Match purchase orders against supplier invoices, payments and goods received.

* Calculate accurate landed costs, including product costs, freight, duties, customs, insurance and other import expenses.

* Allocate landed costs correctly across products and SKUs.

* Monitor inventory movements and investigate discrepancies.

* Reconcile Shopify inventory against warehouse and accounting records.

* Identify missing, damaged, returned or incorrectly recorded stock.

* Prepare regular inventory valuation reports.

* Monitor average daily and weekly sales rates by SKU.

* Calculate product sell-through rates and inventory turnover.

* Calculate weeks and months of stock cover.

* Establish reorder points based on sales velocity, supplier lead times and safety-stock requirements.

* Recommend reorder quantities for individual SKUs.

* Include incoming purchase orders when calculating future stock requirements.

* Forecast potential stockouts and overstock situations.

* Identify slow-moving, ageing and dead stock.

* Track backorders and pre-orders correctly.

* Report the amount of cash currently tied up in inventory.

* Support future purchase-order planning and cash-flow forecasting.

* Help determine when stock should be reordered and how much should be purchased.

* Build clear inventory dashboards and reports management can rely on.



### Financial Reporting and Analysis



* Prepare accurate monthly profit-and-loss statements.

* Maintain a fully reconciled balance sheet.

* Prepare cash-flow reports and short-term cash-flow forecasts.

* Create budgets and compare actual results against budget.

* Explain material variances, unusual movements and emerging financial risks.

* Report profitability by business, store, country, product and SKU.

* Track COGS, freight, fulfilment, merchant fees, advertising, refunds and overheads.

* Calculate gross margin and contribution margin after all variable costs.

* Produce clear weekly and monthly management reports.

* Provide practical commentary instead of simply presenting numbers.

* Highlight opportunities to improve margins, reduce expenses and protect cash flow.

* Help management understand how inventory purchasing will affect future cash requirements.

* Support year-end accounting and provide clean files to external accountants.

* Establish and document reliable accounting processes and internal controls.



## Required Experience



To be considered, you must have:



* At least five years of professional bookkeeping or accounting experience.

* Significant hands-on experience working with e-commerce businesses.

* Advanced practical knowledge of Xero.

* Strong experience reconciling Shopify and payment-gateway transactions.

* Experience with inventory accounting, purchase orders, landed costs and COGS.

* Excellent Excel or Google Sheets skills, including formulas, pivot tables, lookups and financial models.

* The ability to build professional financial and inventory reports.

* A strong understanding of accrual accounting and balance-sheet reconciliations.

* Experience working with multiple currencies.

* Excellent written and spoken English.

* Exceptional attention to detail.

* Strong problem-solving and analytical skills.

* The ability to work independently and meet strict reporting deadlines.

* Complete discretion when handling confidential financial information.



A bookkeeping, accounting or finance qualification is strongly preferred. Xero certification is also highly regarded.



Experience with Shopify, inventory-management platforms, reporting applications or business-intelligence dashboards will be considered a major advantage.



## What Success Looks Like



The right person will ensure that:



* All accounts are current and accurately reconciled.

* Xero remains clean, organised and reliable.

* Shopify sales reconcile correctly to payment-provider deposits.

* Inventory values and COGS are accurate.

* Purchase orders and supplier commitments are clearly tracked.

* Management knows exactly how much stock is available, incoming and required.

* Reorder recommendations are supported by reliable sales and lead-time data.

* Monthly accounts are completed within agreed deadlines.

* Financial reports are clear, accurate and commercially useful.

* Potential problems are identified before they become expensive.

* Management can make decisions confidently based on the numbers provided.



## Who We Are Looking For



We want someone exceptionally professional, reliable and precise. You should naturally question numbers that do not look correct and investigate discrepancies without waiting to be asked.



You must be comfortable taking ownership of the financial records rather than simply completing assigned data-entry tasks. We value accountability, confidentiality, clear communication and consistent attention to detail.



We are specifically looking for a long-term team member who wants to understand the business deeply and continually improve its financial systems and reporting.



## Hours and Salary



* 40 hours per week.

* Monday to Friday.

* Some availability during Australian business hours is required.

* AUD $2,000 per month.

* The advertised salary is fixed, so please apply only if you are comfortable with this rate.

* This is intended to be a stable, long-term position for the right applicant.



## How to Apply



Please include the following in your application:



1. A summary of your bookkeeping and accounting experience.

2. Details of your direct e-commerce experience.

3. The number and size of e-commerce businesses you have previously managed.

4. Your level of experience with Xero, Shopify and inventory accounting.

5. An explanation of how you reconcile Shopify sales and payment-provider payouts.

6. An example of how you calculate reorder points and recommended order quantities.

7. Details of your experience with landed costs, purchase orders and stock forecasting.

8. A redacted example of a financial or inventory report you have created, if available.

9. Your accounting or bookkeeping qualifications.

10. Confirmation that you can work 40 hours per week for AUD $2,000 per month.

11. Your required notice period and earliest available starting date.



Please begin your application with the words **“E-COMMERCE NUMBERS EXPERT”** so we know you have carefully read the complete job description.



Shortlisted applicants may be asked to complete a practical bookkeeping and inventory-reporting assessment.

Prime Renovations builds some of the most beautiful apartments in Manhattan, and we capture footage on our job sites every week. We need a talented editor and social media manager to turn that raw footage into scroll-stopping content for Instagram and other channels.



Our aesthetic is luxury: clean, minimal, black and gold. Think high-end real estate and architecture content, not loud MrBeast-style edits.



What you'll do:



Edit 4+ Instagram Reels per week from raw job site footage our team captures (walkthroughs, before/after reveals, timelapses, craftsmanship detail shots)

Manage our Instagram: write captions, schedule posts, respond to comments and DMs, use relevant NYC design/renovation hashtags

Build simple branded graphics and cover images consistent with our brand (black, gold 

#C6A667, Helvetica)

Repurpose content across platforms (Instagram, YouTube Shorts,
, LinkedIn)

Track performance and adjust the content strategy based on what works

Coordinate with our on-site team on what footage to capture each week using our shot checklist



You're a fit if you have:



A portfolio of short-form vertical video you personally edited (required, applications without links will not be reviewed)

Expert-level skills in Premiere Pro, CapCut Pro, or DaVinci Resolve, including captions, sound design, pacing, and color

Experience growing or managing a business Instagram account

An eye for luxury/architectural aesthetics

Excellent written English for captions and DM replies

Availability to overlap with US Eastern Time at least 2–3 hours daily



How to apply:



Start your application with the word MARBLE so we know you read this post

Include links to 3–5 vertical videos you edited (Reels, TikToks, or Shorts). Tell us which parts you did yourself

Link any Instagram accounts you've managed and what results you drove

title: VIRTUAL ASSISTANT – ACCOUNTS & ADMIN
description:
SJV Cleaning Services | Remote | 5 Hours/Day | Long-Term Role



About Us

SJV Cleaning Services is one of Adelaide's fastest-growing commercial cleaning companies with 200+ five-star Google reviews and 80+ staff. We are expanding and need a detail-oriented VA to join our remote team.



The Role

You will work closely alongside our existing VA to support the day-to-day accounts and admin operations of the business. This is a supporting role, you will be given clear direction and tasks, and are expected to execute them accurately and on time.



What You Will Do

— Xero data entry, reconciliation, and invoice processing

— Accounts payable and receivable support

—
 management and professional correspondence

— General admin tasks including scheduling, data entry, and document management

— Supporting the senior VA with day-to-day operations



What We Need

— Minimum 2 years experience using Xero

— Strong written English

— Organised, reliable, and able to follow instructions accurately

— Comfortable working as part of a small remote team

— Reliable internet and quiet working environment

— Experience supporting an Australian business is a strong advantage



Hours

— 5 hours per day, Monday to Friday

— Australian business hours (ACST)



APPLICATION INSTRUCTIONS

Do NOT apply through OnlineJobs. Applications submitted through the platform will not be considered.



Send your application directly to: 

Subject line: Xero VA Support – [Your Name]



Your
 must include your CV and written answers to ALL of the following questions. Applications missing any answers will not be considered.



ADMIN & SITUATIONAL



1. You are given 10
s to respond to, 3 Xero reconciliations to complete, and a data entry task — all due by end of day. How do you prioritise and manage your time?
