title: Experienced B2B Appointment Setter (Offering Websites)
description:
** PLEASE READ THE ENTIRE DESCRIPTION BEFORE APPLYING **



Hey, I am JT! I am looking for 1-2 hard working appointment setters for my small business. I'm not a big call center where you are just a number. I'm a small business owner and looking for help doing outbound B2B cold calling for me.



I help small businesses with an affordable website. I keep my prices very low ($0 upfront cost and then only $97/month) to attract small business owners who need a website but don't have the skills themselves to make one and don't have the budget to pay thousands for a professional one.



YOUR ROLE:

-- Source your own leads, leads are not provided.

-- Call 60-80 new contacts per 4-hour shift.

-- Offer them a free consultation to learn about an affordable website

-- If they show interest, schedule them for a consultation with me

-- That's it! Once you schedule their appointment I take over.



REQUIREMENTS (DO NOT APPLY UNLESS YOU MEET ALL THE CRITERIA):

-- Experienced B2B Cold Calling and Appointment Setting. This means 100% cold calling — no prior contact, no warm leads.

-- If you have only worked inbound leads, warm leads, or marketing leads, DO NOT APPLY.

-- Clear and confident English communication with no heavy accent.

-- You are someone who is money hungry and motivated to hit your targets.

-- You are reliable with consistent attendance.



HOURS:

-- Part time to start (20 hours), with the option for full time after 30 days.

-- Monday - Friday 10AM-2PM Pacific Standard Time (Tuesday - Saturday 1AM-5AM Philippine Time).



PAYMENT:

-- $20 each qualified appointment that shows up

-- $150 each person who signs up for our services

-- $2/hour base (this is a sales role where the majority of your earnings come from appointments and commissions)

-- Monthly bonuses ranging from $100-$300



HOW TO APPLY:

-- Do not mention previous jobs that are not specifically related to cold calling B2B (no warm leads, no inbound calls, etc)

-- Put "Dial And Smile" as your subject line

-- Copy and paste the following questions and put answers in your application. Please use your own words, and do not use A.I. when replying (yes we can tell):





1) How many months/years of experience appointment setting for B2B cold leads:



2) What product/service were you offering and to who (please be detailed with this response and clear what you were offering):



3) How many calls per day did you average:



4) How many appointments per week did you average:



5) Did you source your own leads or were you given leads:



6) Do you currently have another job:



7) You call a business to offer a website and they say "let me think about it". What do you say and do?



8) What makes you better than other cold callers applying for this role:

title: Commissioned Sales Representative (Phone Sales)
description:
We’re looking for a seasoned phone sales professional to help convert inbound calls and warm leads into closed orders for a fast-growing diesel performance auto parts brand. This is not cold calling. You’ll be working with customers who already have high intent—calling in with questions, requesting quotes, or abandoning carts and needing follow-up.



If you know how to build rapport fast, handle objections, and close confidently on the phone, you’ll thrive here. This is a performance-driven role with real upside for the right closer.



JOB REQUIREMENTS:



Key Responsibilities:

Answer inbound sales calls from customers looking to purchase diesel auto parts

Follow up on warm leads (abandoned carts, form fills, quote requests)

Help customers select the right parts for their truck (training provided)

Overcome objections and close orders on the phone

Log call notes and outcomes in Gorgias / Shopify

Work closely with the operations team to ensure smooth order handoff



Must-Have Skills:

7–10+ years of phone sales experience (inside sales, high-ticket phone sales, B2C or B2B)

Proven ability to close deals (not just take orders)

Excellent spoken English and clear phone presence

Comfortable working U.S. customer hours on weekends

Strong follow-up discipline and CRM hygiene

Auto parts/diesel performance knowledge is a plus, but not required

Competitive, goal-driven, and money-motivated



Performance Expectations

Targets aligned to weekend volume and warm inbound demand

Focus on closing inbound calls and warm follow-ups efficiently



Tools You’ll Use

Aircall – phone system

Gorgias – support + sales inbox

Shopify – order management



Compensation

Base Pay: $7–$12/hour (based on experience and performance in trial)

Performance Bonuses: Ability to earn up to $3,000/month based on sales performance after the first three months

Clear path to increased hourly rate and higher bonus potential for consistent performers

We create educational and marketing content for therapists and private practice owners. We need someone who can take raw video footage and turn it into clean, professional, engaging content for YouTube, Instagram,

Responsibilities

Instagram Reels

TikTok videos

 video content

Short-form educational and promotional clips

Website videos

Training and marketing videos

Captions, transitions, text overlays, music, graphics, and calls to action

You may also be asked to:



Remove pauses, mistakes, filler words, and unnecessary sections

Improve audio quality and overall video flow

Add branded fonts, colors, logos, and graphics

Select strong hooks and engaging 
nts from raw footage

Resize and format videos for each platform

Create clean thumbnails or cover images when needed

Organize completed videos and project files



Required Skills and Experience

You must have:



Previous professional video editing experience

A strong portfolio with examples of both long-form and short-form video editing

Experience editing content for YouTube, Instagram,
, and TikTok

Access to professional editing tools such as CapCut Pro, Adobe Premiere Pro, Final Cut Pro, or similar software

A strong creative eye for clean, modern, professional edits

Excellent attention to detail

A good understanding of pacing, hooks, captions, transitions, music, and viewer retention

The ability to follow brand guidelines and editing instructions

Strong written English and communication skills

Reliable internet access and the ability to download and upload large video files

The ability to meet deadlines consistently



Experience editing educational, coaching, therapy, business, or personal-brand content is preferred.



Turnaround Expectations

Long-form YouTube and playlist edits within 5 to 7 days

Short-form social media videos within 1 to 2 business days

Position Details

Remote

Saltwater Edits

title: Social Media Manager/SEO & Electronics Technician
description:
SmarTech Solutions formerly Mr. Phone Doctor is looking for a creative, organized, and tech-savvy **Social Media Manager** to lead our digital presence across all major platforms. This role goes beyond creating content—you'll work alongside our technicians to capture real repairs, explain technology in a way customers understand, and help grow our brand through engaging, educational, and search-optimized content.



**Electronic technician experience is strongly preferred**, as this position requires an understanding of device repair processes, tools, and electronic components to accurately showcase our work.



## Primary Responsibilities



### Content Creation



* Plan, create, and publish engaging content across
, Instagram, TikTok, YouTube, LinkedIn, Threads, and Google Business Profile.

* Capture high-quality photos and videos of repairs, installations, and behind-the-scenes operations.

* Produce short-form educational videos, customer testimonials, product demonstrations, and promotional campaigns.

* Develop content calendars aligned with business goals, promotions, and seasonal events.



### Technical Knowledge



* Understand smartphone, tablet, computer, and electronics repair processes.

* Correctly identify and describe electronic components such as:



  * ICs (Integrated Circuits)

  * FPC connectors

  * Capacitors

  * Resistors

  * Inductors

  * Filters

  * Charging circuits

  * Motherboard components

* Become familiar with industry equipment including:



  * Microsoldering stations

  * Rework stations (hot air)

  * Precision soldering irons

  * Microscopes

  * Power supplies

  * Diagnostic tools

* Learn repair terminology to accurately explain procedures and create educational content.



### SEO & Digital Marketing



* Research and implement SEO keywords for:



  * Phone repair

  * Computer repair

  * iPad repair

  * Microsoldering

  * Data recovery

  * Security cameras

  * Access control

  * Alarm systems

  * Wi-Fi networking

  * Smart home technology

  * IT services

* Write optimized titles, descriptions, hashtags, and metadata for videos and website content.

* Monitor search trends and recommend new content opportunities.

* Improve local SEO through Google Business Profile updates and location-based content.



### Brand Development



* Maintain SmarTech Solutions' brand voice across all platforms.

* Collaborate with technicians to create educational and entertaining content.

* Assist in developing marketing campaigns for new products and services.

* Promote customer success stories and company milestones.



### Analytics & Growth



* Track engagement, reach, watch time, follower growth, and conversions.

* Provide monthly performance reports with recommendations.

* Stay current with social media trends, algorithm updates, and emerging platforms.



## Qualifications



### Preferred



* Background as an Electronics Technician, Repair Technician, or Computer Technician.

* Experience with smartphone, tablet, computer, or motherboard repair.

* Familiarity with microsoldering terminology and electronic diagnostics.

* Experience creating content for technical or repair-related businesses.



### Required Skills



* Strong photography and videography skills.

* Basic video editing experience (CapCut, Premiere Pro, Final Cut Pro, DaVinci Resolve, or similar).

* Excellent written communication and storytelling abilities.

* Strong understanding of SEO principles and keyword research.

* Ability to learn new technologies quickly.

* Highly organized with strong attention to detail.

* Comfortable working in a fast-paced repair environment.



## Bonus Qualifications



* Experience with Adobe Creative Cloud.

* Drone photography or videography.

* Graphic design experience (Canva, Photoshop, Illustrator).

* Knowledge of YouTube optimization and analytics.

* Experience running paid social media advertising campaigns.

* Basic HTML or WordPress experience.



## What Success Looks Like



* Consistently creates engaging, educational content that builds trust with customers.

* Accurately explains repair procedures using proper technical terminology.

* Produces SEO-focused content that increases website traffic and local search visibility.

* Helps grow SmarTech Solutions' audience and brand recognition across multiple platforms.

* Works closely with technicians to capture authentic repairs and installations while maintaining professionalism and accuracy.

title: Funding Specialist
description:
Read this if you know how to get people funded



We help everyday Americans rebuild their credit, then we help them turn that credit into real capital. When a family goes from "denied" to "funded," it changes what they can build and how far they can go. That is the work.



We move with discipline, we treat people right, and we play the long game.



Here is the opportunity: funding is a brand-new department, and you are the one who builds it. You are not stepping into a machine and YOU are the person who designs the machine. If that excites you instead of scaring you, you are exactly who we are looking for.



- The Role -



You run the funding side of the business. When a client finishes our credit program and reaches a 700+ profile, you take them from approved on paper to funded in the bank.



You will secure:



-0% business credit cards (card stacking)

-Business lines of credit

-Personal loans

-SBA-backed funding



…for clients who are ready to build and scale.



- What you will own-



-Consult with funding-ready clients and map the right funding strategy for each one

-Secure funding through 0% credit card stacking, business lines of credit, personal loans, and SBA products

-Build and protect lender and bank relationships

-Own the pipeline end to end, from handoff, to funded, to fee collected

-Build the system, the SOPs, scripts, and processes this department runs on

-Hit a monthly funded-dollars target and report your numbers every week



- Who we are looking for -



-You have funded real clients before. Background in business credit, funding consulting, loan brokering, merchant services, or business banking.

-You know 0?rd stacking. You know which banks approve what, and how to sequence applications so inquiries do not work against the client.

-You can sell. This is a consultative close, not order-taking.

-You protect the client. We will never push someone into a product that hurts them. Our brand is built on trust, and you will guard it.

-You are comfortable being measured on funded dollars and revenue.

-Strong written and spoken English and excellent communication, you are advising Americans on their finances.



- Nice to have - 



-Existing lender or bank relationships

-Experience building a funding or finance department from the ground up

-Familiarity with GoHighLevel



- Compensation -



Base pay plus commission on collected success fees, paid after funding lands. Your income scales directly with the dollars you fund. Top performers earn six figures easily. This is a role for someone who wants their pay tied to their results, not capped by a salary.



Base: To be discussed

Commission: % of collected success fees (full structure shared in the interview)



- What success looks like in your first 90 days -



-The funding pipeline is built and running

-The handoff from the credit team is clean and automated

-Your first clients are funded and fees collected

-A repeatable process exists that a second advisor could step into without you having to rebuild it



- How to apply -



We read every application from people who actually read the job. To show you did:



Start your message with the word "FUNDED."

-Tell us about one real client you personally took from approved to funded: the product, the challenge, and the dollar amount.

-List the banks and lenders you have worked with and what you know about their approval patterns.





Applications that skip these steps will not be reviewed.

title: Fractional Marketing Director
description:
# Fractional Marketing Director / Growth Marketing Lead for Growing Home-Service Company



NOTE: Candidates must have proven experience independently managing a company’s marketing strategy and execution, preferably within the home services industry.



## About the Role



Cultivate House Detailing is looking for an experienced, highly accountable **Fractional Marketing Director / Growth Marketing Lead** to take ownership of our lead-generation strategy.



We are a growing home-service company based in Colorado Springs, Colorado. Our services include window cleaning, gutter cleaning, pressure washing, holiday lighting, permanent lighting, screen repair, and other exterior home services.



Our primary marketing challenge is simple:



**We need to consistently generate more qualified leads at a profitable cost.**



We are not looking for someone who only posts on social media, runs a few ads, or gives us a list of recommendations. We need someone who can look at the entire marketing system, identify the biggest opportunities, create a focused plan, and ensure that the work gets completed.



This may begin as a fractional position. We care more about measurable results, ownership, and communication than a specific number of hours worked.



## Your Mission



Build and manage a predictable marketing system that produces qualified leads for Cultivate throughout the year.



You will be responsible for answering questions such as:



* Where should our next marketing dollar go?

* Which services, offers, and geographic areas should we prioritize?

* Why are campaigns succeeding or failing?

* What should we test next?

* Where are leads falling out of the funnel?

* How do we reduce our dependence on any single lead source?

* How do we prepare marketing campaigns ahead of our seasonal demand?



## What You Will Own



### Marketing Strategy



* Develop and maintain Cultivate’s overall marketing plan.

* Create quarterly, monthly, and weekly marketing priorities.

* Build campaigns around our seasonal service calendar.

* Identify the highest-impact opportunities for generating leads.

* Recommend appropriate budgets based on expected returns.

* Help develop stronger offers, hooks, promotions, and positioning.

* Turn leadership’s ideas into organized campaigns with deadlines and ownership.



### Paid Advertising



* Manage or oversee Google Ads and Meta advertising.

* Review campaign structure, keywords, targeting, creative, landing pages, and conversion tracking.

* Monitor cost per lead, cost per booked job, lead quality, and return on advertising spend.

* Create a structured testing process for ads, offers, audiences, and landing pages.

* Scale successful campaigns without allowing performance to deteriorate.

* Quickly identify and correct campaigns that are wasting money.



### Local Search and SEO



* Improve our visibility in Colorado Springs, Monument, Black Forest, Woodland Park, and surrounding service areas.

* Develop a practical local SEO plan.

* Improve service pages and location pages.

* Help manage our Google Business Profile strategy.

* Identify content opportunities that can generate qualified local traffic.

* Coordinate review-generation and reputation-marketing efforts.



### Website and Conversion Optimization



* Review the customer journey from the first click through booking.

* Improve landing pages, quote forms, calls to action, and conversion rates.

* Help launch and market our instant window-cleaning quote system.

* Work with our team or outside developers to implement website improvements.

* Make decisions using customer behavior and conversion data rather than personal preference.



###
, SMS, and Database Marketing



* Build campaigns that generate additional revenue from our existing customer and lead database.

* Create seasonal reactivation, cross-sell, upsell, referral, and follow-up campaigns.

* Improve lead nurturing for customers who request an estimate but do not immediately book.

* Develop campaigns that introduce existing customers to additional services.

* Coordinate messaging through Housecall Pro, OpenPhone, or other systems as appropriate.



### Content and Creative Direction



* Develop a practical content plan tied to lead generation and brand awareness.

* Create clear briefs for advertisements, videos,
s, landing pages, and social content.

* Help us find better advertising hooks and angles.

* Review creative work and provide specific, useful feedback.

* Personally write or edit important marketing copy when necessary.

* Coordinate freelancers, designers, editors, or other specialists when appropriate.



### Tracking and Reporting



* Make sure marketing attribution and conversion tracking are accurate.



* Develop a simple weekly marketing scorecard.



* Track metrics such as:



  * Leads by source

  * Qualified leads

  * Cost per lead

  * Cost per booked job

  * Booking rate

  * Revenue by lead source

  * Return on advertising spend

  * Website conversion rate

  * Speed to lead

  * Customer acquisition cost



* Send a concise weekly report explaining:



  * What happened

  * Why it happened

  * What was completed

  * What is being tested

  * What needs leadership’s attention

  * What will happen next



We do not want reports that only show traffic, impressions, followers, or activity. Reporting must connect marketing work to leads, booked jobs, and revenue.



## Strategy and Execution



This is not a purely advisory role.



You should be able to operate at three levels:



1. **Strategy:** Determine what Cultivate should do and why.

2. **Management:** Organize projects, assign work, and ensure deadlines are met.

3. **Execution:** Personally complete important work when hiring another specialist would be unnecessary or inefficient.



You do not need to be the world’s best specialist in every channel. You must, however, understand each major channel well enough to make good decisions, evaluate performance, and manage specialists effectively.



## What Success Looks Like



### During Your First 30 Days



* Learn our services, customer base, service area, seasonality, brand, and current sales process.

* Audit our current advertising, website, SEO, tracking, content, CRM, and follow-up systems.

* Identify immediate waste, broken tracking, and missed opportunities.

* Establish a simple marketing scorecard.

* Present a prioritized 90-day marketing plan.

* Begin implementing the highest-impact improvements.



### Within 60 to 90 Days



* Establish dependable campaign planning and reporting.

* Improve our ability to identify which channels produce booked work.

* Launch structured tests across our highest-priority channels.

* Improve lead follow-up and database reactivation.

* Build an organized campaign calendar for our major services.

* Demonstrate measurable progress in lead volume, lead quality, booking rate, or customer acquisition cost.



### Long-Term



* Build a diversified and predictable lead-generation system.

* Help Cultivate plan marketing proactively rather than reactively.

* Reduce wasted spending.

* Increase qualified leads and booked revenue.

* Create repeatable systems that can support the company as it grows.



## Required Experience



We are looking for someone who has:



* At least 4 years of meaningful digital marketing experience.

* Experience owning marketing outcomes, not merely completing assigned tasks.

* Strong working knowledge of Google Ads and Meta Ads.

* Experience with local SEO and Google Business Profiles.

* Experience improving landing pages and conversion rates.

* Experience with
 and SMS marketing.

* Strong copywriting and offer-development skills.

* Experience reading marketing data and explaining it clearly.

* Experience managing multiple campaigns and deadlines.

* Excellent written and spoken English.

* Strong judgment, initiative, organization, and attention to detail.

* A history of working independently without needing constant instruction.



Experience marketing a home-service company, local service business, franchise, or appointment-based company is strongly preferred.



## Helpful Experience



These are not all required, but they would be valuable:



* Housecall Pro or another home-service CRM

* Google Analytics 4

* Google Tag Manager

* Looker Studio

* Call tracking

* WordPress

*
 and Instagram content

* YouTube or short-form video

* Direct mail or neighborhood marketing

* Referral programs

* Reputation management

* Seasonal campaign planning

* Managing designers, video editors, copywriters, or advertising specialists

* Using AI tools to improve speed without sacrificing quality



## Who Will Succeed in This Role



You may be a strong fit if you:



* Think like a business owner rather than a task-based freelancer.

* Ask good questions before spending money.

* Focus on revenue and qualified leads rather than vanity metrics.

* Are comfortable making recommendations and respectfully challenging weak ideas.

* Can create structure in an environment where many opportunities compete for attention.

* Communicate problems early rather than hiding them.

* Can explain complex marketing decisions in plain English.

* Know how to prioritize rather than attempting ten initiatives at once.

* Are equally comfortable analyzing numbers and developing creative ideas.

* Take responsibility for outcomes while being honest about what marketing can and cannot control.



## Who Should Not Apply



This role is probably not a fit if you:



* Only specialize in social media posting.

* Require detailed instructions for every task.

* Primarily measure success through followers, impressions, or engagement.

* Create strategies but depend on others to organize and implement everything.

* Cannot show examples of campaigns connected to leads, sales, or revenue.

* Take on more clients than you can properly support.

* Frequently miss deadlines or disappear when a project becomes difficult.

* Use generic AI-generated marketing plans without understanding the business.



## Schedule and Working Arrangement



This is a remote, flexible, results-based position.



We are open to a fractional arrangement, consulting relationship, or a larger ongoing role depending on the candidate’s experience and proposed approach.



You may generally organize your own working hours. However, you must be available for:



* A regular weekly marketing meeting.

* Occasional meetings during Colorado business hours.

* Timely communication when campaigns or tracking systems have problems.

* Reasonable collaboration with our Colorado-based leadership and operations team.



We are not requiring a full United States night shift.



## Compensation



Compensation is negotiable based on:



* Experience

* Demonstrated results

* Proposed scope

* Weekly capacity

* Whether you will personally execute work or manage other specialists



Please include your desired monthly compensation or retainer in your application.



We are interested in building a long-term relationship with the right person. We are open to beginning with a defined paid trial or initial 90-day engagement before expanding the role.



## How to Apply



Please do not send a generic cover letter.



Begin your application with the words:



**“I have experience independently managing a company's marketing strategy”**



Then answer the following questions:



1. Tell us about a company where you were responsible for generating leads. What was the business, what did you personally own, and what results did you achieve?



2. Which marketing channels are you strongest in? Which channels would you prefer to oversee rather than execute personally?



3. Imagine you joined Cultivate and discovered that we were running Google Ads and Meta Ads, publishing social content, and working on SEO, but no one could reliably explain which activities were creating booked jobs. What would you do during your first 30 days?



4. Give an example of a marketing campaign that was underperforming. How did you diagnose the problem, and what did you change?



5. What metrics would you include in a weekly marketing scorecard for a local home-service company?



6. How many clients or employers are you currently supporting?



7. How much capacity would you realistically have for Cultivate?



8. What monthly compensation or retainer are you requesting?



9. Please provide links, screenshots, case studies, reports, landing pages, advertisements, or other examples that demonstrate your work. You may remove confidential information.



10. Record a short video, no longer than five minutes, introducing yourself and explaining the first three things you would want to learn about our business.



## About Cultivate House Detailing



Cultivate House Detailing is a growing home-service company serving Colorado Springs and surrounding communities.



Our services include:



* Residential window cleaning

* Gutter cleaning

* Pressure washing and soft washing

* Screen repair and rebuilding

* Holiday light installation

* Permanent lighting

* Solar-panel pigeon protection

* Other exterior home-detailing services



Our company values are:



* Empathy

* Humility

* Community

* Growth



We care about excellent customer service, strong communication, employee development, and building a company that serves both our customers and our community well.



We are looking for someone who wants to help build a marketing department, not simply complete a temporary list of tasks.

title: Cold Caller | Sales Development Specialist
description:
# Cold Caller / Sales Development Specialist

## Team Lead Track

**Remote | Full-Time | U.S. Business Hours**



## About the Role

We are looking for an experienced, high-performing **Cold Caller and Sales Development Specialist** who can take ownership of outbound sales conversations—from researching and contacting prospects to qualifying opportunities, nurturing leads, and securing qualified bookings, appointments, or onsite walkthroughs.



This is not an entry-level dialing role. We need an **A-player** who can think strategically, communicate confidently, handle objections, create genuine interest, and move qualified prospects toward a clear next step.



The right candidate must also be able to create, test, and improve sales scripts, assist with lead generation when calling lists are limited, and potentially train and lead other callers as the department grows.



## Role Objective

The primary objective is to generate qualified sales opportunities by:

* Reaching the appropriate decision-makers

* Understanding the prospect’s current situation and needs

* Identifying genuine problems or service opportunities

* Properly qualifying the prospect

* Creating enough interest to secure a booking, consultation, or walkthrough

* Maintaining consistent follow-up until a clear outcome is reached

* Supporting lead-generation efforts when additional prospects are needed



The focus is not simply on call volume. Success will be based on the quality of conversations, qualified opportunities created, appointments booked, appointment attendance, and the overall quality of the handoff to management.



## Key Responsibilities

### Cold Calling and Outbound Sales: 

* Make consistent outbound calls to businesses and prospective clients.

* Contact business owners, managers, directors, facility managers, office managers, and other relevant decision-makers.

* Navigate receptionists, gatekeepers, and front-desk personnel professionally.

* Introduce the company and its services clearly and confidently.

* Create interest without sounding aggressive, robotic, or overly scripted.

* Conduct natural and consultative sales conversations.

* Ask strong discovery and qualification questions.

* Identify operational challenges, service needs, contract timing, dissatisfaction, and buying motivation.

* Handle common objections confidently and professionally.

* Secure qualified phone appointments, consultations, estimates, bookings, or onsite walkthroughs.

* Maintain strong activity levels without sacrificing conversation quality.



### Lead Qualification: 

* Determine whether a prospect meets the company’s established qualification criteria.

* Identify the correct decision-maker and their level of authority.

* Understand the prospect’s current provider or service arrangement.

* Identify relevant needs, challenges, dissatisfaction, or opportunities.

* Determine timing, urgency, level of interest, and readiness to move forward.

* Confirm that booked appointments or walkthroughs represent legitimate opportunities.

* Avoid booking unqualified prospects simply to increase appointment numbers.

* Recognize buying signals and guide interested prospects toward the appropriate next step.

* Clearly distinguish between qualified, unqualified, nurturing, unavailable, and non-responsive leads.

* Provide management with clear and accurate information about each qualified opportunity.



### Lead Nurturing and Follow-Up: 

* Follow up with prospects who expressed interest but were not ready to book immediately.

* Nurture long-term opportunities through phone calls, SMS, and
 when applicable.

* Re-engage older leads, missed opportunities, no-response prospects, and previous inquiries.

* Maintain consistent follow-up without over-contacting prospects.

* Track callback dates, contract renewal periods, future interest, and decision timelines.

* Ensure qualified prospects do not fall through the cracks because of poor follow-up.

* Build familiarity and trust with prospects over multiple conversations.

* Move nurturing leads toward a booked appointment, walkthrough, or clear final outcome.



### Appointment and Walkthrough Booking

* Convert qualified interest into booked appointments, consultations, estimates, or walkthroughs.

* Confirm the appointment date, time, location, contact person, and decision-maker.

* Clearly explain the purpose and value of the appointment.

* Confirm that the prospect has genuine interest before booking.

* Set the correct expectations before handing the opportunity to management or the field sales team.

* Reduce cancellations and no-shows through proper qualification and confirmation.

* Follow up on missed, cancelled, or rescheduled appointments.

* Provide a complete and accurate handoff to the appropriate manager.

* Confirm that all relevant prospect information has been collected before the appointment.



### Lead Generation and Prospect Research

When the available calling list has been completed or additional prospects are needed, the candidate will be expected to assist with lead generation.



Responsibilities include:

* Researching businesses through Google, LinkedIn, Google Maps, company websites, directories, and approved lead-generation tools.

* Identifying businesses that meet the company’s target-market criteria.

* Finding business owners, managers, directors, facility contacts, and other decision-makers.

* Gathering phone numbers,
 addresses, locations, company information, and relevant business details.

* Verifying leads before submitting them to the team.

* Identifying duplicate, invalid, closed, irrelevant, or low-quality leads.

* Helping build clean, organized, and properly targeted calling lists.

* Prioritizing leads based on company size, service need, location, decision-maker accessibility, and opportunity value.

* Identifying new industries, territories, or business categories that may present sales opportunities.

* Supporting the team in maintaining a consistent supply of qualified prospects.



### Sales Script Development and Optimization

The successful candidate must be capable of independently creating, testing, and improving high-converting sales scripts.



This person should not rely solely on a company-provided script. They must be able to:

* Create original cold-calling scripts based on the company’s services, target market, buyer profile, and campaign objective.

* Research the target industry before developing the calling approach.

* Develop separate approaches for gatekeepers, decision-makers, follow-up calls, nurturing, reactivation, appointment setting, and closing.

* Formulate strong opening statements, discovery questions, qualification questions, value propositions, objection responses, and closing transitions.

* Adjust messaging for different industries, services, prospect types, and levels of awareness.

* Create scripts that sound conversational and consultative rather than robotic.

* Test different openings, questions, offers, and calls to action.

* Review call recordings, prospect reactions, objections, and conversion results.

* Identify where conversations are breaking down.

* Make evidence-based adjustments to improve performance.

* Continuously optimize scripts based on measurable results.

* Document approved scripts so they can be taught and replicated by other callers.

* Create supporting objection-handling guides, follow-up frameworks, and call-flow documents.

* Train tea
mbers to understand the reasoning behind the script rather than simply reading it word for word.



Candidates should be prepared to explain their script-development process and provide examples of scripts or calling frameworks they have previously created.



A script will only be considered proven when it consistently produces measurable improvements such as:

* More decision-maker conversations

* Higher qualified-lead rates

* Improved booking or walkthrough conversion

* Stronger follow-up results

* Fewer early call rejections

* Better appointment attendance

* Higher-quality sales opportunities



The objective is to create a repeatable and scalable calling system, not simply a script that sounds good on paper.

### Call Documentation and System Familiarity

CRM and pipeline management will remain under upper management. However, the candidate must understand how to work within company systems and accurately document sales activity.



The candidate should be able to:

* Enter clear call notes after each meaningful conversation.

* Record relevant prospect information, objections, needs, and next steps.

* Update basic contact information when required.

* Schedule callbacks and follow-up activities.

* Follow the company’s established call-disposition and documentation procedures.

* Understand how leads move through a sales process.

* Provide accurate information so management can oversee the pipeline effectively.

* Learn the company’s CRM and calling systems quickly.

* Review sales activity and conversion information when developing scripts or coaching callers.

* Understand CRM and pipeline processes sufficiently to support a future leadership role.



The candidate will not be responsible for overall CRM administration, pipeline design, workflow management, or management-level reporting unless the role later develops into a formal leadership position.



### Training and Leadership Development

This position has the potential to develop into a senior or team-lead role.

The successful candidate should be able to:

* Demonstrate calling practices that can become the standard for the team.

* Help onboard and train new callers.

* Teach other callers how to qualify prospects and create genuine interest.

* Train tea
mbers on scripts, discovery questions, objection handling, follow-up, and natural call delivery.

* Review call recordings and provide constructive feedback.

* Identify common performance issues and recommend improvements.

* Help create call-quality scorecards and coaching standards.

* Lead roleplays and call-practice sessions.

* Coach callers on improving confidence, tone, questioning, and closing ability.

* Help management evaluate caller readiness and performance.

* Hold callers accountable for activity, quality, and accurate call documentation when formally assigned.

* Help improve team conversion rates.

* Maintain professionalism, discipline, and consistency.

* Progress into a Senior Caller, Call Coach, Sales Trainer, or Calling Team Lead role based on performance.



## Required Experience

Candidates must have strong experience in several or all of the following:

* B2B cold calling

* B2C cold calling

* Outbound sales

* Appointment setting

* Lead qualification

* Consultative selling

* Lead nurturing

* Objection handling

* Prospect research

* Lead generation

* Phone, SMS, and
 follow-up

* Booking consultations, estimates, sales calls, or onsite walkthroughs

* Speaking with business owners and senior decision-makers

* Creating sales scripts from the ground up

* Testing and optimizing calling scripts

* Reviewing call recordings and conversion results

* Training or coaching other callers

* Supporting or leading an outbound sales team

* Working within CRM and calling systems



## Preferred Industry Experience

Experience in one or more of the following is highly preferred:

* Commercial cleaning

* Janitorial services

* Facility services

* Property services

* Home services

* Carpet cleaning

* Restoration

* Construction

* Landscaping

* Automotive services

* Hospitality

* Professional services

* Marketing or business services

* Other service-based businesses



## Required Skills and Qualifications

* Impeccable spoken and written English

* Clear, professional, and easily understandable accent

* Strong and confident phone presence

* Excellent listening skills

* Strong discovery and qualification ability

* Ability to build rapport quickly

* Ability to communicate professionally with executives and decision-makers

* Strong objection-handling skills

* Comfortable asking direct qualification questions

* Comfortable asking for a booking or commitment

* Ability to adapt naturally during conversations

* Strong research and analytical skills

* Ability to formulate and improve sales messaging independently

* Strong organizational and time-management skills

* Accurate call documentation

* Self-motivated and proactive

* Able to work independently with limited supervision

* Able to receive coaching and implement feedback

* Comfortable working with KPIs, scorecards, and recorded calls

* Familiarity with CRM, calling, and follow-up systems

* Reliable attendance and punctuality

* Reliable internet connection

* Quiet and professional remote working environment

* Quality headset and computer

* Leadership potential

* Ability and willingness to train others



## What We Are Not Looking For

This position is not suitable for someone who:

* Only reads scripts word for word

* Cannot create or improve a sales script

* Books unqualified appointments to meet a quota

* Avoids speaking with decision-makers

* Gives up after one or two follow-ups

* Requires constant supervision

* Leaves incomplete or unclear call notes

* Cannot handle objections

* Is uncomfortable asking for the appointment

* Focuses only on call volume

* Waits for leads instead of helping generate them

* Is unwilling to review calls or improve performance

* Cannot adjust their approach based on results

* Has unreliable attendance or communication



## What Success Looks Like

The successful candidate will:

* Consistently reach appropriate decision-makers.

* Conduct confident and professional conversations.

* Identify genuine business needs.

* Properly qualify prospects.

* Book high-quality appointments and walkthroughs.

* Maintain a strong appointment attendance rate.

* Follow up consistently with developing opportunities.

* Generate additional qualified leads when calling lists are limited.

* Provide management with accurate and complete prospect information.

* Create and improve strong-converting scripts.

* Reduce unqualified bookings and no-shows.

* Help improve the performance of other callers.

* Become a trusted senior member of the sales team.

* Demonstrate readiness for a future leadership position.



## Performance Metrics

Performance may be measured using:

* Outbound calls completed

* Meaningful conversations

* Decision-maker contacts

* Qualified leads generated

* Appointments or walkthroughs booked

* Appointment show rate

* Qualified booking rate

* Lead-to-appointment conversion rate

* Follow-up completion rate

* Lead-nurturing conversion

* Lead-generation output

* Accuracy and quality of call notes

* Call-quality score

* Objection-handling ability

* Script performance

* Attendance and schedule adherence

* Coaching participation

* Team contribution

* Leadership readiness

Call volume alone will not determine success. We will evaluate both quantity and quality.



## Tools You May Use

Experience with the following is beneficial:

* GoHighLevel

* HubSpot

* Salesforce

* Zoho CRM

* RingCentral

* Dialpad

* Aircall

* Google Workspace

* Google Sheets

* LinkedIn

* Google Maps

* Business directories

* Lead-generation tools

*
 and SMS platforms

* Call-recording and quality-assurance systems



Training will be provided on company-specific tools and processes.



## Schedule



* Full-time remote position

* Must be available during U.S. business hours

* Required schedule: **M-F**

* Time zone: **PST**

* Reliable attendance and punctuality are required



## Compensation

* Base compensation: **$7-8 (negotiable)**

* Appointment or performance incentives: **Depending on bonus**



Compensation will be based on experience, English communication, sales ability, proven results, and leadership potential.



## Career Growth

High-performing candidates may progress into roles such as:



* Senior Sales Development Representative

* Senior Cold Caller

* Call Quality Coach

* Sales Trainer

* Calling Team Lead

* Outbound Sales Supervisor

* Sales Operations Coordinator



Advancement will be based on performance, accountability, conversion ability, coaching skills, and consistency.



## Application Requirements

To apply, please submit:

1. Your updated résumé.

2. A summary of your cold-calling and outbound sales experience.

3. The industries or services you have previously sold.

4. Your experience qualifying leads.

5. Your experience booking appointments, estimates, or walkthroughs.

6. Your experience generating your own prospect lists.

7. Your experience working with CRM and calling systems.

8. Your experience creating or improving sales scripts.

9. Your experience training, coaching, or leading callers.

10. A voice recording introducing yourself and describing your strongest sales achievement.

11. Your available schedule and time zone.

12. Your expected hourly or monthly rate.



Begin your application with the following statement:



**“I am ready to own the conversation.”**

Applications without a voice recording or relevant outbound sales experience may not be considered.



## Final Note

We are looking for someone who takes ownership of sales conversations and results.

title: Senior GL Accountant (US Focus)

This role is ideal for accounting professionals who are confident working independently, partnering cross-functionally, and operating within process-driven finance environments that value accuracy, accountability, and continuous improvement.



Who This Role Is For



We are looking for professionals who thrive in:

• US accounting environments

• Multi-entity operations

• Cross-functional finance teams

• High-volume and fast-paced close cycles

• Process-driven accounting environments

• Roles requiring strong ownership and accountability



Role Overview



The Senior GL Accountant will take ownership of key accounting functions including:

• General ledger management

• Month-end and year-end close

• Financial reporting support

• Balance sheet reconciliations

• Audit preparation and compliance

• Process improvement initiatives



Depending on business needs, the role may also support multi-entity reporting structures and cross-functional finance operations.



Key Responsibilities

General Ledger & Close

• Own and manage assigned general ledger accounts

• Prepare and review journal entries including:

Accruals

Deferrals

Depreciation

Amortization

Reclassifications

Revenue and expense adjustments



• Lead monthly, quarterly, and annual close activities

• Perform and review balance sheet reconciliations and bank reconciliations

• Investigate and resolve reconciling items promptly

• Maintain accurate supporting schedules and audit-ready workpapers

• Ensure completeness and accuracy of financial records



Financial Reporting & Analysis

• Support preparation of monthly financial reports and supporting schedules

• Perform variance and flux analysis with clear explanations

• Assist with management reporting and ad hoc financial analysis

• Ensure proper cutoff and period-end accuracy



Technical Accounting & Compliance

• Ensure compliance with US GAAP and company accounting policies

• Support internal and external audit activities

• Maintain strong internal controls and documentation standards

• Review transactions for proper accounting treatment

• Assist in implementing accounting process improvements and best practices



Multi-Entity & Cross-Functional Support

• Support intercompany and multi-entity reconciliations

• Handle multi-currency transactions and FX adjustments

• Coordinate closely with AP, AR, Payroll, FP&A, and Operations teams

• Act as point of contact for assigned entities or business units



Process Improvement

• Identify opportunities to streamline and improve accounting workflows

• Support close acceleration and accounting optimization initiatives

• Assist in documenting accounting procedures and SOPs

• Support ERP and finance system enhancement projects



Required Qualifications

• Bachelor’s Degree in Accounting or Finance

• Strong understanding of US GAAP

• Minimum 5+ years of progressive accounting experience

• Proven ownership of month-end close processes

• Strong experience with general ledger accounting and reconciliations

• Hands-on ERP experience (NetSuite or similar preferred)

• Advanced Microsoft Excel skills

• Strong analytical and problem-solving skills

• Excellent attention to detail and organizational ability

• Strong written and verbal communication skills

• Ability to work independently and meet deadlines effectively



Preferred Qualifications

• CPA or equivalent certification is a strong advantage

• Experience supporting US-based companies

• Multi-entity and intercompany accounting exposure

• SOX/internal controls experience is an advantage

• Public accounting background is a plus

• Experience mentoring or reviewing work of junior accountants is an advantage

• Experience working within high-growth or fast-paced environments is preferred



Application Instructions



To be considered for this position, please submit the following:



• Your application letter

• Unrestricted link to your updated resume/CV

title: Virtual Operations Coordinator
description:
# Virtual Operations Coordinator



### Full-Time | Independent Contractor | U.S. Home-Service Company



**Compensation:** PHP 45,000–85,000 /
USD per month, based on experience

**Schedule:** Monday–Saturday, 9:00 AM–5:00 PM Mountain Time

**Philippine Schedule:** Approximately 11:00 PM–7:00 AM

**Location:** Remote, Philippines



## About Cultivate House Detailing



Cultivate House Detailing is a growing home-service company based in Colorado Springs, Colorado. We provide window cleaning, gutter cleaning, pressure washing, holiday lighting, and other exterior home services.



We care deeply about delivering an excellent customer experience while building an organized, dependable company.



We are looking for someone who can become a trusted owner of our office operations, not simply an assistant waiting for instructions.



## The Role



We are hiring a full-time Virtual Operations Coordinator to help manage customer communication, scheduling, lead follow-up, job preparation, and daily office operations.



This is **not an entry-level order-taking position**.



We need someone who can:



* Recognize what needs to be done without being reminded

* Take responsibility for an area of the business

* Identify problems before they become emergencies

* Investigate issues and propose solutions

* Follow established systems while improving them when necessary

* Keep tasks moving from beginning to completion

* Communicate clearly when something is blocked or requires a decision



You will receive training, clear expectations, and access to our systems. However, we do not want to provide step-by-step instructions for every situation.



The right person will think like an operations manager, not a task-based freelancer.



## Key Responsibilities



### Customer Communication



* Answer inbound phone calls professionally and confidently

* Respond to customer texts and
s

* Call new leads quickly and consistently

* Answer basic questions about our services and processes

* Follow up with customers who have not scheduled

* Resolve routine customer concerns without unnecessary escalation

* Keep customers informed when schedules or circumstances change



### Scheduling and Coordination



* Schedule estimates and service appointments

* Review the calendar for conflicts, gaps, and potential problems

* Confirm that jobs are assigned correctly

* Check upcoming jobs for missing information

* Monitor weather and identify jobs that may need attention

* Communicate with technicians regarding schedule changes or job details

* Follow through until scheduling issues are completely resolved



### Lead and Sales Support



* Monitor new leads and ensure they receive a fast response

* Follow up on unscheduled estimates and open opportunities

* Keep accurate notes in the CRM

* Identify leads that are being neglected or falling through the cracks

* Support promotions, customer reactivation, and seasonal campaigns

* Help improve our speed-to-lead and booking rate



### Job Preparation and Follow-Through



* Review upcoming jobs for complete notes, addresses, scope, and customer details

* Identify missing information before the service date

* Confirm that customers receive necessary reminders

* Follow up with field staff when information or action is needed

* Monitor incomplete tasks and make sure they are closed out

* Assist with post-job follow-up, review requests, and customer concerns



### Systems and Process Improvement



* Maintain accurate information in Housecall Pro and other company systems

* Create or improve checklists, templates, and standard operating procedures

* Notice repeated problems and recommend better systems

* Document solutions so the same issue does not continue happening

* Help management improve organization and accountability

* Take ownership of recurring responsibilities without waiting for reminders



## What Ownership Looks Like in This Role



If a customer has not received a response, you follow up.



If a job is missing important information, you investigate and correct it.



If the calendar has a problem, you do not simply report it. You determine the available options and recommend a solution.



If a technician has not responded, you follow up through the appropriate channels and keep the issue moving.



If you make a mistake, you communicate it honestly, correct it, and help create a system that prevents it from happening again.



If you notice the same problem happening repeatedly, you bring forward a proposed process improvement.



Your responsibility is not just to complete individual tasks. Your responsibility is to help produce a dependable result.



## Required Qualifications



* Previous experience independently managing office operations, customer service, scheduling, or administrative responsibilities

* Demonstrated ability to manage responsibilities without constant supervision

* Strong problem-solving and critical-thinking skills

* Excellent spoken and written English

* Comfortable speaking with American customers by phone

* Professional, warm, and confident phone presence

* Highly organized and attentive to detail

* Able to prioritize multiple responsibilities

* Comfortable learning new software and troubleshooting basic issues

* Fast and reliable internet connection

* Reliable computer, headset, and quiet workspace

* Willing and able to work consistently during U.S. Mountain Time business hours



Experience with a home-service company is strongly preferred. Experience with Housecall Pro, OpenPhone, Slack, or a similar CRM is also helpful.



## This Position Is Not a Good Fit If You:



* Need to be told every individual task to complete

* Regularly wait for reminders before following up

* Stop working on an issue as soon as something unexpected happens

* Report problems without attempting to understand or solve them

* Are uncomfortable making reasonable decisions within established guidelines

* Frequently miss details or leave tasks unfinished

* Prefer a role with minimal responsibility or accountability

* Cannot reliably work overnight Philippine hours



## What We Provide



* Full-time, long-term work

* Clear expectations and areas of responsibility

* Training on our company, services, and systems

* Written processes and support during onboarding

* Opportunities to take on greater responsibility as the company grows

* A respectful working environment where good ideas are welcomed

* The ability to make a meaningful impact on a growing U.S. company



## Compensation and Employment Structure



This is a full-time independent contractor position.



Compensation is **PHP 50,000–70,000 per month**, depending on experience, communication skills, and demonstrated ability to manage responsibilities independently.



Final candidates will complete a paid trial designed to evaluate communication, judgment, organization, follow-through, and problem-solving.



## How to Apply



Please include all of the following in your application:



1. Begin your application with the words **“I Take Ownership”** so we know you read the complete posting.



2. Send a short voice or video introduction explaining:



   * Your previous experience

   * Why you are a strong fit for this role

   * What taking ownership means to you



3. Describe one responsibility you previously managed without supervision. Explain:



   * What you were responsible for

   * How you kept track of the work

   * What decisions you made independently

   * What result you produced



4. Describe a time you noticed a problem before your manager did. What did you do?



5. Imagine that tomorrow’s schedule contains a job with incomplete notes, the assigned technician is not responding, and the customer expects arrival at 8:00 AM. Explain how you would handle the situation.



6. Include a screenshot of a current internet speed test.



Generic applications or applications that do not answer these questions will not be considered.



We are looking for someone who wants to become a dependable, trusted part of our company and take genuine ownership of their work.

title: Executive Operations Manager (Future Chief of Staff)
description:
Most people are looking for a job. 



I’m looking for my right hand.



Not someone to just manage my calendar or check off tasks.



Someone who genuinely enjoys building systems, solving problems, organizing chaos, and making an entire company run better.



If you often think, “There has to be a better way to do this,” keep reading.





About PestLaunch



PestLaunch helps pest control companies install the systems they need to grow:

- Dashboards & financial systems

- Reporting & accountability

- Hiring and operational processes

- AI, automation, and execution



We don’t sell fluff. We make business owners better operators.



We’re growing quickly and I need someone who wants to grow alongside the company.



This is not a normal Executive Assistant role.



If you’re happiest waiting for instructions, you won’t enjoy this.



If you naturally notice problems early, enjoy improving systems, and constantly ask, “How can we make sure this never happens again?” this role was built for you.





Your Mission: Protect my time.



Your job is to make sure I only do the things only I can do.

Everything else, you:

- Systemize

- Delegate

- Organize

- Improve

- Solve





What You’ll Own



Executive Support

- Inbox & calendar management

- Scheduling, follow-up, reminders

- Meeting preparation & notes

- Protecting deep work time

- Making sure nothing important slips through the cracks



Client & Financial Admin

- Client onboarding, agreements, CRM updates

- Payment links, billing, renewals, failed payment follow-up

- Vendor payments, expense monitoring, flagging unusual charges

- Coordinating with bookkeeping



Internal Ops & Projects

- Employee onboarding & software accounts

- Google Drive and internal organization

- Vendor management & team resources

- Tracking projects, owners, deadlines, and follow-ups

- Removing blockers so projects actually finish



SOPs, Systems & Continuous Improvement

- Building SOPs, checklists, and Looms for recurring work

- Improving processes so we solve problems once, not repeatedly

- Every week asking:

  - What can I take off Landon’s plate?

  - What’s disorganized or repetitive?

  - What should be automated or simplified?





What Success Looks Like (6 Months)

- I rarely open my inbox.

- Projects move forward without me chasing anyone.

- New hires have a clean, consistent onboarding.

- We solve recurring problems with systems, not reminders.

- The business gets more organized every month.

- I spend more time growing the company, less time managing it.





You

You’d describe yourself as:

- Extremely organized, detail-oriented, and proactive

- Assertive and comfortable speaking up

- Resourceful, calm under pressure, and high ownership

- A strong communicator and natural systems thinker

You don’t wait for work; you look for opportunities to improve.





Required Experience



Please only apply if all of these are true:

- 3+ years supporting a CEO, founder, or executive directly

- Experience managing projects across a remote team

- Experience creating SOPs and improving systems

- Excellent written and spoken English

- Comfortable working US business hours

- Stable high-speed internet and quiet workspace

- Professional webcam and microphone for daily video calls

- Looking for a long-term, full-time role (no other full-time clients)



Bonus (not required):

- GoHighLevel, Whop, QuickBooks, Google Workspace

- ClickUp / Monday / Asana

- Online consulting / implementation businesses





What I Value More Than Experience

I can teach software and the business.

I cannot teach ownership.



I’m looking for someone who:

- Thinks two–three steps ahead

- Closes loops without reminders

- Brings recommendations, not just problems

- Wants to build something great over the long term





How To Apply

Subject line: Executive Operations Manager – YOUR NAME – APPLY



Include in your message:

1. A short description of your experience supporting a founder or CEO.

2. A time you permanently eliminated a recurring problem with a system:

  - What was the problem?

  - What did you build?

  - What was the result?

3. The best SOP or operational improvement you’ve ever created.

4. One example of when you anticipated a problem before your CEO noticed.

5. A 2–3 minute Loom:

  - Introduce yourself

  - Walk me through a system, process, or workflow you’re proud of building



Also attach:

- Your resume (PDF)

- Internet speed test screenshot



Applications that don’t follow these instructions won’t be considered. Attention to detail is part of the job.

title: Meta & TikTok Performance Creative Designer (Video + Static) Luxury Short-Term Rental Brand | Houston, Texas | Remote |
description:
Meta & TikTok Performance Creative Designer (Video + Static)

Luxury Short-Term Rental Brand | Houston, Texas | Remote | Part-Time or Full-Time





---



## Who We Are



We operate a luxury furnished rental portfolio in Houston, Texas — four premium townhomes in one private compound, accommodating groups of 10 to 40 guests.



We are building a **world-class direct booking brand** and running paid ads on Meta 
/Instagram) and TikTok nationwide to generate bookings directly — bypassing Airbnb and VRBO entirely.



Our properties are located in the heart of Houston — minutes from:

- Texas Medical Center (largest in the world)

- Downtown Houston and Midtown

- NRG Stadium and Toyota Center

- The Galleria and Uptown

- Memorial Park

- Museum District

- Major conference centers and corporate hubs

- Montrose

- River Oaks



This location is our superpower. **Your job is to make people feel it.**



---



## Our Guests — The ICPs You Will Create For



Every creative you make targets one specific guest type. Here is the full list:



| ICP | Who They Are |

|---|---|

| **Wedding Groups** | Bridal parties, wedding guests, families attending weddings — need space for 10–40 people in one place |

| **Bachelor / Bachelorette Parties** | Groups celebrating before the big day — want luxury, privacy, and a Houston experience |

| **Corporate Travelers & Extended Stay** | Business professionals, executives, consultants on 30–90 day assignments needing a home, not a hotel |

| **Family Reunions** | Extended families traveling from across the country who want everyone under one roof |

| **Medical Center Visitors** | Patients and families at Texas Medical Center needing comfortable, long-term accommodation nearby |

| **Relocation Families** | Families moving to Houston who need furnished, flexible housing while they find their permanent home |

| **Film & Production Crews** | TV, film, and commercial crews needing a private compound as a base of operations |

| **Sports Travelers** | Groups attending NFL, NBA, MLB, or major sporting events at Houston stadiums |

| **Concert & Event Groups** | Friend groups and fan communities traveling to Houston for major concerts and festivals |

| **Insurance Housing Guests** | Families displaced from their homes who need immediate, comfortable group accommodation |

| **Construction & Trade Crews** | Workers on long-term Houston projects needing furnished, affordable group housing |

| **Luxury Weekend Travelers** | High-income groups wanting a premium Houston experience — rooftop, compound, full amenities |

| **Airbnb / Hotel Alternative** | Groups currently splitting across multiple hotel rooms or Airbnb units who don't know a better option exists |

| **University & Academic Groups** | Students, professors, or visiting scholars attending conferences or programs at Houston universities |

| **Sports Teams & Coaches** | Amateur and semi-pro teams traveling to Houston for tournaments needing team accommodation |



---



## Why Video Is the #1 Priority



**Video is our most powerful weapon.** A 15-second video does what a static image cannot — it educates, it sells the dream, it shows the property, and it speaks directly to one specific person's situation.



Here is exactly how our videos work:



### The 15-Second Video Formula



**Seconds 0–10: The Property**

- Walkthrough footage of the compound — interior, rooftop, living spaces, exterior, all four townhomes

- Drone footage showing the compound from above

- High-quality clips and photos mixed together

- Goal: make the viewer say *"wow"* in the first 3 seconds



**Seconds 10–15: The Location**

- Quick cuts showing proximity to Houston landmarks

- Texas Medical Center, downtown skyline, NRG Stadium, Memorial Park, The Galleria

- Communicates: *"You're not just getting a great property — you're in the perfect location"*



### The ICP Layer (What Changes Per Video Version)



On top of the base video, each version gets:



1. **A static lifestyle photo** — a realistic image of the target guest type placed on screen (bottom corner, ~30% of screen). Examples:

   - Wedding version: photo of a bridal party

   - Corporate version: photo of a professional team

   - Family reunion version: multi-generational family group

   - Bachelorette version: group of women celebrating

   - Medical version: family in a warm, supportive setting



2. **A single caption** — one question or statement that speaks directly to that ICP's situation. Examples:

   - *"Coming to Houston for a wedding? Need the perfect place for your group of 10–40?"*

   - *"Relocating to Houston? Don't split your family across hotel rooms."*

   - *"Extended stay in Houston? Live like a local — not a hotel guest."*

   - *"Bringing your whole crew to Houston? One compound. Everyone together."*

   - *"Coming to Houston for treatment at the Medical Center? Stay close. Stay comfortable."*



**The same base video is reused across all ICP versions. Only the lifestyle photo and caption change.** This is how we produce high volume efficiently.



### Static Ads — Also Important



While video is the priority, we also need static image ads for:

- Retargeting campaigns

- Carousel ads showing multiple rooms and spaces

- Split testing hooks quickly

- Audiences that respond better to image ads



Static ads follow the same ICP logic — property photo combined with a lifestyle image and a direct response headline.



---



## What You Will Actually Do Day-to-Day



### Video Creative Production

- Edit 15-second ICP-targeted video ads from our walkthrough and drone footage

- Layer static lifestyle photos on top of the base video per ICP

- Add captions and text overlays

- Produce multiple versions — one per ICP — from a single base video

- Use AI video tools to supplement footage where needed (Kling, Vidu, CapCut, etc.)



### Static Creative Production

- Create static image ads combining property photos with ICP lifestyle images

- Create carousel ads showcasing rooms, spaces, and amenities

- Create collage-style creatives for different audience segments

- Produce multiple headline and hook variations per concept



### Creative Strategy & Volume

- Proactively generate new creative concepts — do not wait to be asked

- Research what competitor short-term rental and hotel brands are running on Meta and TikTok

- Bring new ideas for hooks, angles, and formats

- Produce high volume — multiple variations per ICP, per format, per week



### Systems

- Follow our Creative Bible and SOPs

- Deliver files organized, named, and ready to upload

- Accept feedback and iterate quickly



---



## What You Will Receive From Us



- All raw walkthrough video footage and drone footage

- Property photos (interior, exterior, rooftop, compound)

- Customer avatar guides for every ICP

- Caption and copy examples for each ICP

- Creative playbooks with reference examples

- Direct, fast feedback on every batch

- A long-term role with a path to Lead Creative Strategist



---



## Tools You Should Know



**Video (Required):**

- CapCut (primary video editing tool)

- OR DaVinci Resolve / Premiere Pro / any professional editor



**AI Video & Image Generation (Strong Bonus):**

- Kling, Vidu 2.0, or Runway (AI video generation)

- Midjourney, Krea, or Freepik (AI lifestyle image generation)

- HeyGen or Arcads (AI avatar/UGC generation)



**Static Design (Required):**

- Canva Pro



**Copy & Ideation:**

- ChatGPT or Claude



**Research:**

- Meta Ads Library (competitor ad research)

- TikTok Creative Center



---



## Ideal Background



? Video editing for social media ads (Meta, TikTok, Instagram Reels)

? Static image ad creation

? Direct response advertising — you understand hooks, CTR, and conversion

? Hospitality, vacation rentals, Airbnb, hotels, or real estate (big bonus)

? High-volume creative production

? Working from raw footage to finished ad with minimal direction



You understand:

- The **first 3 seconds** of a video d
 everything

- A **hook** is not a title — it is a pattern interrupt

- **Buyer psychology** — pain points, dream outcomes, social proof

- The difference between content that looks good and content that **converts**

- How to make someone feel like an ad was made **specifically for them**



---



## How to Apply



**Do not send a generic application. We will not read it.**



We evaluate candidates based on their **trial work**, not their CV. Read the instructions below carefully — this is your interview.



---



### Step 1: Submit Your Portfolio

- At least **2 examples of video ads** you edited (15–30 seconds, social media format)

- At least **2 examples of static image ads** you created

- Bonus: any hospitality, real estate, or luxury brand work

- If you don't have hospitality examples, show us your best direct response work and explain your thinking



---



### Step 2: Answer These Questions (written — keep answers concise)



**Q1:** What makes a 15-second video ad convert? Walk us through your thinking — hook, structure, and close.



**Q2:** We want to target bachelorette groups coming to Houston. Describe the video ad you would make:

- What does the base video show?

- What lifestyle photo sits on screen?

- What does the caption say?



**Q3:** We want to target corporate professionals on extended stays (30–90 days) in Houston. Describe the static image ad you would make:

- What is the image combination?

- What is the headline?

- What is the text overlay?



**Q4:** We want to target families relocating to Houston who need temporary furnished housing. Describe both a video version AND a static version of this ad.



**Q5:** Create ONE complete ad concept — ready to produce — for this hook:



> *"Stop Booking 10 Hotel Rooms in Houston."*



Tell us: Who is the target audience? What does the video or image show? What does the caption say?



---



### Step 3: Tell Us About You

- Where are you based?

- What video editing and design tools do you use daily?

- Are you available part-time, full-time, or either?

- What is your rate — per video, per static, or per hour?

- How quickly can you deliver a 15-second edited video once you have the footage?



---



## Trial Process



We do not do multiple interview rounds. Here is how we hire:



1. You apply with your portfolio and written answers above

2. If we like your answers, we send you our raw footage, a Creative Brief, and one ICP assignment

3. You produce **one 15-second trial video** and **one static ad** from the brief

4. We review the output and make a decision

5. If selected, you start immediately on a per-creative paid basis with a path to full-time



**The trial is paid.** We respect your time.



---



## Compensation



- **Trial:** Paid per creative — rate agreed before trial begins

- **Ongoing:** Per creative or hourly — negotiated based on output and quality

- **Growth path:** Top performers become our **Lead Creative Strategist** — expanded scope, higher pay, long-term partnership

- Part-time or full-time — we are flexible



---



## One Last Thing



We are building something serious in Houston. We want someone who gets excited about this — who watches our walkthrough footage and immediately starts thinking *"I know exactly what I'd do with this."*



If that's you — apply now. Send your portfolio and your answers. We move fast.



**We look forward to seeing your work.**

• Excellent attention to detail, organization, and the ability to juggle multiple client files without dropping deadlines

• Ability to work independently with minimal supervision

• Reliable internet connection and availability during agreed working hours

• Strong written English communication

Desired / an asset

• Direct experience working with Canadian companies

• Familiarity with Canadian GST/HST filing and compliance

• Prior experience in a bookkeeping firm or outsourced/multi-client environment

What we offer

Maverix is a young, rapidly growing pickleball company. Because we are still building our team, this is a unique opportunity to join early, make a meaningful impact, and grow into a leadership position within the company.



WHAT YOU’LL BE RESPONSIBLE FOR

, TikTok, and YouTube accounts

* Generating original content ideas that fit our brand and audience

, and YouTube Shorts

* Staying current with trends, platform changes, and successful content within the sports industry

* Reviewing performance data and using it to improve future content

* Taking ownership of projects, meeting deadlines, and communicating progress clearly

* Helping shape the long-term creative direction and voice of the Maverix brand



REQUIREMENTS



* At least three years of professional social media management experience

* Strong working knowledge of Instagram,
, TikTok, and YouTube

* Proven experience growing or improving business social media accounts

* Ability to create a strategy and execute it without constant direction

* Strong short-form video-editing skills

* Ability to edit photos and create professional static graphics

* Experience using tools such as Canva, CapCut, Adobe Premiere Pro, Photoshop, or similar programs

* Excellent organization and time-management skills

* Strong written English and communication skills

* Creative, trustworthy, accountable, and dependable

* Comfortable receiving feedback and continuously improving your work



THE IDEAL PERSON



You do not simply complete assigned tasks—you notice opportunities and take initiative.



You should be able to look at our social media accounts and tell us what is working, what is not working, and exactly what you would do to improve them. We want someone who brings ideas to the table, follows through on commitments, and takes pride in producing excellent work.



HOURS AND GROWTH OPPORTUNITY



This position will begin at approximately 15 hours per week. As long as the work being produced is valuable to Maverix, we intend to increase both the hours and compensation.



Our ultimate goal is for this person to grow into a full-time, long-term position and eventually oversee the creative direction of our social media department.



We believe strongly in rewarding people who work hard, produce valuable results, and help the company grow. If you take care of Maverix and consistently deliver great work, we will make sure you are taken care of as well.



HOW TO APPLY



Please include the following with your application:



1. A short introduction explaining why you would be a strong fit for Maverix

7. Your current availability

3. What would you do differently with our content and brand moving forward?

4. What would your top three priorities be during your first 30 days?

We are not looking for generic social media advice. We want thoughtful, specific recommendations that show you reviewed our page, understand our brand, and can think strategically.
