We are looking for someone who can make people feel comfortable, listen carefully, ask the right questions, and reassure them that they contacted the right firm that can help them.



The ideal candidate genuinely enjoys talking to people and knows how to build trust quickly over the phone.

You should be warm, confident, engaging, and comfortable guiding conversations. Strong active-listening and sales skills are extremely important. You should be able to hear what someone is saying, understand the problem they are facing, respond naturally, and help move the conversation toward scheduling a consultation that they will attend or taking the appropriate next step to retain the firm and make a payment. 



Responsibilities will include:

• Working on eastern standard time business hours, potentially 1-2 hours after 5pm 

• Answering incoming calls from existing and potential clients in both English and Spanish

• Speaking with potential clients to understand why they are calling and what problems they are facing and using active listening to make them feel heard and understood

• Reassuring potential clients and helping them feel confident that they have come to the right place

• Scheduling consultations and appointments, with a focus on helping potential clients feel comfortable and committed to show up to the appointment, and/or motivated to take the next step and retain the firm

• Following up with scheduled potential clients to improve appointment attendance and reduce no-shows

• Following up with potential clients who completed a consultation but have not yet hired the firm, with the goal of helping qualified leads move forward and hire the firm

• Maintaining consistent and professional communication with clients and leads

• Updating client and lead information in our CRM

• Assisting with calendaring, administrative tasks, and general law firm support as needed



We are especially interested in someone who:

• Speaks and writes fluent English and Spanish

• Has excellent phone and communication skills

• Is warm, friendly, confident, and comfortable speaking with new people

• Has strong sales instincts and knows how to build rapport without sounding pushy

• Practices active listening and can respond thoughtfully during conversations

• Is persistent and comfortable following up with leads

• Is motivated and confident to help potential clients take the next step and hire the firm

• Is organized, reliable, and detail-oriented

• Is comfortable learning new technology and systems

• Wants to grow with a growing company



Must have a good computer with fast reliable internet, and power. Experience with sales, customer service, intake, legal work, bankruptcy, social media, CRM systems, or calendar management is a plus.

More than anything, we are looking for someone with the right personality: someone confident, sharp, motivated, engaging, dependable, kind, and genuinely good with people.



There is significant opportunity to learn, take on additional responsibilities, and grow within the firm over time.

title: ## E-commerce Static Ads Designer — Canva & AI Experience Required
description:
We are looking for a talented and commercially minded **Graphic Designer** to join our team and create high-performing **static advertisements for e-commerce brands**.



This position is not only about making designs look attractive. We are looking for someone who understands how visual design, marketing psychology, customer pain points, product benefits, and persuasive messaging work together to create advertisements that capture attention and drive sales.



### Main Responsibilities



* Create high-quality static ads for
, Instagram, TikTok, Google,
 campaigns, landing pages, and other e-commerce marketing channels.

* Design mainly in Canva while maintaining a professional, polished, and brand-consistent visual standard.

* Use AI tools as part of the creative process, including image generation, background creation, product placement, visual enhancements, concept development, and creative variations.

* Turn marketing ideas, product benefits, customer pain points, reviews, and promotional offers into clear and visually compelling advertisements.

* Create multiple creative concepts for the same product rather than producing repetitive variations of one design.

* Conduct basic market and competitor research before beginning the design process.

* Review successful international e-commerce brands and competitors to identify strong creative angles, layouts, messaging styles, offers, and visual trends.

* Use competitor advertisements as inspiration while creating original designs that fit our brands.

* Work according to proven advertising concepts, such as:



  * Problem and solution

  * Before and after

  * Customer testimonial

  * Product benefits

  * Pain-point-focused messaging

  * Comparison ads

  * Educational ads

  * Promotional and offer-based ads

  * Lifestyle and emotional concepts

  * Product feature highlights

  * UGC-style static ads

* Create strong visual hierarchy so the main message, product, offer, and call to action are immediately clear.

* Adapt designs to different audiences, products, brand identities, languages, and campaign goals.

* Organize Canva files professionally and ensure designs can be easily reviewed, edited, and reused by the team.

* Deliver creative variations for testing different headlines, hooks, images, formats, layouts, and marketing angles.

* Improve designs based on feedback and advertising performance data.



### What We Are Looking For



* Strong Canva skills and experience creating professional marketing designs.

* A good eye for branding, typography, composition, spacing, color balance, and visual hierarchy.

* Experience creating static advertisements, ideally for e-commerce brands or direct-response marketing campaigns.

* Practical experience using AI tools as part of the design workflow.

* A basic or advanced understanding of e-commerce marketing.

* Understanding of customer pain points, desires, objections, product benefits, and purchasing motivations.

* Ability to understand the purpose of an advertisement and communicate one clear message without making the design overcrowded.

* Ability to research competitors and identify creative concepts that are already performing well in the market.

* Ability to follow brand guidelines while still bringing new and creative ideas.

* Strong attention to detail and a commitment to producing polished, finished work.

* Ability to work independently, manage multiple tasks, and meet deadlines consistently.

* Good communication skills and the ability to understand feedback and apply revisions accurately.

* A proactive mindset. We want someone who can suggest concepts and improvements, not only wait for detailed instructions.



### Important



We are not looking for someone who only knows how to use Canva templates.



The ideal candidate should understand the difference between a visually attractive social media post and an e-commerce advertisement designed to generate clicks, interest, and purchases.



Every creative should have a clear purpose, a strong marketing angle, and an organized visual structure. The designer should be able to understand what the customer needs to see, feel, and understand within the first few seconds.



### Examples of Tasks



You may receive a product page, brand guidelines, customer reviews, competitor links, or a short creative brief.



Your task may include:



* Researching the product and target audience

* Identifying the strongest customer pain points

* Finding inspiration from international competitors

* Suggesting several advertising concepts

* Writing or improving short headlines and supporting text

* Creating the final static ad in Canva

* Producing several variations for testing

* Using AI to create or improve relevant visual assets



### Preferred Experience



Experience in any of the following areas will be considered an advantage:



* E-commerce and direct-response advertising

* Meta Ads creative production

* Shopify brands

* Dropshipping or direct-to-consumer brands

* Consumer products, fashion, beauty, wellness, supplements, accessories, or children’s products

* AI image generation and image editing

* Marketing copywriting

* Creative strategy

* Competitor and market research

* Creating ads in multiple languages

* Working with performance marketers or media buyers



### What Success Looks Like



A successful designer in this role will consistently create advertisements that:



* Look professional and match the brand

* Communicate the main message quickly

* Highlight relevant customer pain points and product benefits

* Feel modern, original, and commercially focused

* Are based on research rather than random design choices

* Provide enough creative variety for meaningful advertising tests

* Require minimal corrections before being ready for launch

* Improve over time based on feedback and campaign results



### How to Apply



Please include the following in your application:



1. A short introduction about your experience.

2. A portfolio with relevant static ads, preferably for e-commerce brands.

3. Examples of Canva designs you personally created.

4. Examples of how you have used AI in your design process.

5. A short explanation of how you approach competitor research and creative concept development.

6. Your availability and expected rate.

7. The AI tools you currently use.

8. Your favorite e-commerce advertisement or brand creative and why you believe it works.



Please do not apply without relevant design examples.



We are looking for someone interested in a stable, long-term working relationship. There will be ongoing work for multiple e-commerce brands and products, with opportunities to take on more responsibility as the collaboration develops.

title: Listing Coordinator (Property Onboarding) $2k-$3kUSD to+ 13th Month | Full-Time Salaried | Night Shift (Hawaii Hours)
description:
Hawaii Coastal Property Management (HiCoastal) is a full-service property management brokerage in Honolulu, Hawaii, managing long-term rentals, short-term/vacation rentals, mid-term rentals, community associations, and commercial properties across the island of Oahu. We are led by a former U.S. Naval Officer and run a disciplined, systems-driven, AI-first operation: we expect our team to use modern tools (including AI assistants) to work faster and smarter than the competition.



We are hiring ONE exceptional person for a long-term, exclusive, salaried role. This is not project work and not freelancing. If hired, HiCoastal is your only client.



The Role



You will own the pipeline that takes a new rental property from "owner just signed with us" to "live, listed, and rent-ready." Every new homeowner who joins HiCoastal hands us a property that needs a sequence of things done before it can be listed: inspections, cleaning, repairs, photography, utility transfers, key/smart-lock setup, listing content, and more. Your job is to make sure every one of those steps happens, in the right order, on time, with nothing dropped.



Concretely, you will:



- Serve as the coordination hub for every new property onboarding from signed agreement to live listing

- Follow up relentlessly with homeowners to collect documents, approvals, access details, and decisions — you are the person who never lets a task go stale

- Schedule and sequence vendors and our local Hawaii tea
mbers (inspectors, cleaners, handymen, photographers) so work happens in the correct order — you cannot photograph a unit before it's cleaned, and you cannot clean it before repairs are done

- Manage and deconflict calendars across multiple tea
mbers and properties simultaneously

- Track every active onboarding in our systems and surface blockers before they become delays

- Communicate proactively: owners, teammates, and vendors should never have to ask "what's the status?"

- Reason about the big picture: when one appointment slips, you understand the downstream impact and re-sequence the whole chain without being told



You are NOT a general virtual assistant. This is a specialist role with a single mission: properties get to market fast, and nothing falls through the cracks.



Who We're Looking For



Must-haves:



- 3+ years in a coordination-heavy remote role (real estate transaction/listing coordination, property management, project coordination, executive assistance with heavy scheduling, or similar)

- Demonstrated mastery of calendar and scheduling logistics across multiple people and time zones

- Excellent written AND spoken English — you will be on the phone and on video with American homeowners and our Hawaii team

- A driven, self-starting operator. We will give you the mission and the tools; we will not micromanage your task list. If you need daily direction, this is not your role

- Strong logical reasoning — you can hold a multi-step dependency chain in your head and re-plan when reality changes

- Meticulous follow-up habits. You track your own open loops without being reminded

- Comfortable adopting new software quickly, including AI tools (we will train you on our stack)



Nice-to-haves:



- Experience with property management software (AppFolio, LeadSimple, Hostaway, Buildium, or similar)

- U.S. real estate experience (listings, rentals, or transactions)

- Experience working Hawaii or U.S. West Coast hours



Schedule — Read Carefully



This is a NIGHT SHIFT role on Philippine time. You will work full Hawaii business hours:



- 8:00 AM – 5:00 PM Hawaii Standard Time, Monday–Friday

- That is 2:00 AM – 11:00 AM Philippine time

- Hawaii does not observe daylight saving time, so this schedule never shifts



Do not apply if you cannot sustainably work this shift long-term. We need someone live and responsive during our business day: owners and vendors operate on Hawaii time, and scheduling is the core of this job.



Compensation & Benefits



- $2,000-$3,000 USD per month, fixed salary (not hourly)

- 13th month pay

- Performance raises and bonuses: we promote and reward people who take ownership and deliver

- Long-term, stable, exclusive role with a growing company

- Direct access to leadership and real investment in your professional growth, including training on cutting-edge AI workflows

- 90 Day probationary period before converting into a tenured position with paid vacations.  1 Week in first year, 2 weeks paid vacation each year going forward after first year.



Technical Requirements



- Reliable high-speed internet (25+ Mbps) with a backup connection

- Backup power solution (outages are not an acceptable reason to miss a scheduled owner call)

- Quiet, professional workspace suitable for video and phone calls

- Modern computer with webcam and quality headset



How to Apply



We read every application, but we filter hard. Follow these instructions exactly — applications that skip any step will not be considered.



1. Start your application with the word LIGHTHOUSE in the first line.  If it does not have this, your application will be discarded.

2. In 150 words or less, describe the most complex multi-party scheduling situation you have personally managed and how you kept it on track.

3. Answer this scenario in 100 words or less: A property's repair appointment on Tuesday gets cancelled by the handyman. Photography is booked Thursday, the cleaning is booked Wednesday, and the owner expects the listing live Friday. What do you do, in what order?

4. Include a link to a 1–2 minute unscripted video of yourself explaining why this specific role fits you (Loom, Google Drive, or YouTube unlisted).  Your video must have the words Hawaii Coastal Property Management in the opening introduction and must have been recorded after the date of this job posting.  If it is not, your application will be discarded.

5. Confirm explicitly that you can work 2:00 AM – 11:00 AM Philippine time, Tuesday–Saturday, long-term.  Also the last line of your application message must contain the words 'I'm ready' if it does not your application will be disgarded.



We are looking for First Class talent, so we will be paying accordingly.



We will move fast with strong candidates: application review ? paid test task ? video interview ? offer.

title: Creative Video Editor (DaVinci Resolve) - AI-Powered Ad Studio
description:
CREATIVE VIDEO EDITOR - AI-POWERED AD STUDIO (REMOTE)



Join a next-generation marketing agency where human creativity meets cutting-edge technology.



We're a creative marketing agency building the future of advertising - producing high-quality video ads by pairing the latest AI technology with real human creative taste. We don't believe you have to choose between the two: the technology handles the heavy lifting, and you bring the eye, the judgment, and the craft that makes an ad actually land.



We're growing fast, and we're looking for a Creative Video Editor to join us - initially part-time, with a clear path to full-time as we scale together.



WHAT YOU'LL BE EDITING



- Our clients' video ads - high-performing creative for real advertising campaigns

- Our own agency content - the videos that market us as a creative agency, including our YouTube channel (both paid and organic)

- Both stills and video - you'll also help edit and polish our photography (our shoot stills), not just the moving picture



Real variety, real creative range, and a front-row seat to how a modern agency actually operates.



WHY THIS ROLE IS DIFFERENT



Most editing jobs are a grind of repetitive busywork. This one isn't. We've built an AI-powered workflow that does the heavy lifting for you - project setup, transcription, structuring the cut, sourcing b-roll, building graphics and sound effects. That frees you to focus on the part only a human can do: choosing, shaping, and elevating.



You'll work smarter, not harder, with the newest creative tools at your fingertips - and you'll help us push them even further.



WHERE THIS CAN LEAD



We're not just hiring an editor - we want to train the next generation of frontier editors. As you grow with us, this role opens a real path to managing other editors and leading the full creative process end to end. If you want to be at the cutting edge of where creativity and technology meet, this is where you do it.



WHO WE'RE LOOKING FOR



- A genuine creative eye and taste - you know what makes a video feel great

- Detail-oriented and tidy in everything you do

- Open-minded and curious - you're excited to work with the latest tools and technology in creative editing, not intimidated by it

- Collaborative - you thrive in a team that values ideas and rewards innovation

- A reliable communicator who wants a long-term relationship, not a one-off gig

- Comfortable with DaVinci Resolve (this is what we use)



THE ARRANGEMENT



- Part-time to start (around 4 hours a day, Monday to Friday), with the possibility of full-time as we grow together

- Remote - work from wherever you are

- $650/month, based on experience

- Full training on our system, tools, and workflow



HOW TO APPLY



Apply through OnlineJobs.ph with your CV and a link to your portfolio / showreel.



Shortlisted candidates will be invited to a short paid test edit so we can see how you work.



We can't wait to see what you'll create with us.

description:

Creative Content Assistant



International Ecommerce Men's Fashion Brand  |  Full Time  |  Long Term  |  Remote



We are hiring a talented, detail-oriented Creative Content Assistant to work directly with the founder of a fast-growing international men's fashion brand.



Our biggest growth driver is fresh, high-quality creative for Meta ads. Your job is to keep that pipeline full: organising our content library, editing video and image ads, and producing new variations every week so our ads never go stale.



This is NOT VA role, and it is NOT a customer support role. We already have a strong customer support team. This role is about making great content, fast, to a high standard.



We are looking for a maker: someone who loves editing, has an eye for what stops the scroll, and takes pride in producing volume without dropping quality.



A keen eye for a classy, minimalistic editing style: clean cuts, restrained effects, and premium typography that bring an elevated, high-status feel to the content



Your main goal is simple: keep a steady flow of fresh, tested ad creative flowing to the founder every single week.

Responsibilities



• Edit video ads from raw UGC, creator content, and product footage (hooks, cutdowns, captions, music, pacing)

• Create image ads and graphics in Canva or Photoshop (statics, carousels, story/reel formats)

• Produce iteration batches on winning ads: new hooks, new openings, new formats, new text overlays

• Resize and adapt creative for all Meta placements

• Organise and maintain our content library so every asset is named, tagged, and findable

• Manage the content calendar and keep the testing queue full

• Follow creative briefs from the founder, then suggest your own ideas as you learn what works

• Light coordination: following up with content creators for raw footage and usage approvals



Essential skills (do not apply without these)

• Video editing (CapCut, Premiere Pro, or similar) with work you can show us

• Canva and/or Photoshop

• Meta ads & direct-response creative

• Content creation for Fashion, apparel, or fitness brands

• Strong visual eye: you can tell a scroll-stopping ad from a boring one, and explain why

• Excellent written and spoken English

• Extreme attention to detail (file naming, spelling in captions, brand consistency)

• Organised and reliable: you hit deadlines without being chased

• Comfortable using AI tools (Claude, ChatGPT, AI image/video tools) in your workflow



Bonus if you have experience with

• Social media management

• Copywriting for ads (hooks, headlines, captions)

• Motion graphics or animation



An interest in fashion, design, social media, copywriting, and marketing would be beneficial. 



Who we are:

We are a family owned and operated business with strong ethical and family values. We treat our team with compassion and care, and we're committed to nurturing the right candidate: helping you grow your skills, develop your creative and leadership ability, and become the best version of yourself. We also offer flexibility for family care, because we understand family comes first. If you need to work around school runs, appointments, or caring for loved ones, we'll make the schedule work with you, as long as the work gets done to a high standard.



What winning looks like in this role



• The founder launches new creative every week without ever opening an editing tool

• Our content library is so organised that any asset can be found in under a minute

• Winning ads get fresh iterations before they fatigue

• Ticking off your assigned edits with no ideas or improvements of your own

• You grow with the business: over time you will learn Meta ads strategy, creative direction, and advanced AI skills directly from the founder, with real career progression as the team grows



We are profitable, growing fast, and building a long-term team. We pay reliably, respect your time, and promote from within.



IMPORTANT: To apply, you MUST include all four of the following



Applications missing any of them will not be read.



1. Links to your work (required). Include links to at least 3 pieces of content you personally created (video ads, social content, graphics: Google Drive, portfolio, TikTok, Instagram, or YouTube links are all fine). Tell us for each one: what it was for, what you did yourself, and which one performed best and why.



2. A short video of yourself (required). Record a 1 to 2 minute selfie video (Loom or phone camera is fine, no editing needed) answering this one question: “Pick one ad or piece of content you've seen recently that you thought was great. What made it work?” We want to hear you talk, not read a script.



3. Answer these 4 questions briefly (a few sentences each, specifics beat length):

1. Which brands or clients have you edited content for? Name them, or describe them if under NDA.

2. What is your exact editing setup? (Software, and whether you edit on phone, tablet, or computer)

3. We send you 20 raw clips from a content creator on Monday morning and need 3 finished video ad variants by Wednesday. Walk us through your process, step by step.

4. How do you know if your edit has worked well compared to others? What do you look at, and what would you change based on it?

4. Final instruction. Start your application with the phrase:



“Fresh creative wins”



Applications that do not follow all instructions will be ignored.

title: SEO Specialist (Google Rankings & On-Page SEO)
description:
# SEO Specialist (Local SEO & Technical SEO)



Penguin Party Rentals is looking for an experienced SEO Specialist to help improve our Google rankings and increase organic traffic.



This is **not** a content writing or blog writing position. We are looking for someone with hands-on SEO experience who understands how to grow a local service business through search engines.



## Responsibilities



* Perform SEO audits and identify opportunities for improvement.

* Conduct keyword research and competitor analysis.

* Optimize existing website pages for search engines.

* Improve title tags, meta descriptions, heading structure, internal linking, and image optimization.

* Resolve technical SEO issues that affect rankings.

* Monitor website performance using Google Search Console and Google Analytics.

* Develop strategies to improve rankings for local search results.

* Track keyword rankings and provide regular progress reports.

* Recommend and implement SEO best practices.



## Requirements



* Proven experience improving Google search rankings.

* Strong understanding of on-page, off-page, and technical SEO.

* Experience with Google Search Console and Google Analytics.

* Experience using SEO tools such as Ahrefs, Semrush, Screaming Frog, or similar.

* Understanding of local SEO, Google Business Profile optimization, schema markup, and citation building.

* Excellent English communication skills.

* Ability to explain SEO recommendations in a clear and organized manner.



## Nice to Have



* Experience with AI tools to assist with SEO workflows.

* Basic HTML/CSS knowledge.

* Experience with WordPress or other CMS platforms.



## To Apply



Please answer the following:



1. Tell me about a website you helped rank on Google.

2. What keywords or rankings did you improve?

3. What SEO tools do you use regularly?

4. Share screenshots or examples of your results if available.

5. What is your level of spoken and written English?



**Please do not apply if your primary experience is content writing, copywriting, or social media management. We are specifically looking for an SEO specialist with proven ranking experience.**

title: AI Video Ads Creator (Performance Marketing)
description:
About the Role



We're looking for an exceptional AI Video Ads Creator to join our team. This isn't a traditional video editing role—we're looking for someone who lives and breathes AI creative and knows how to produce high-converting video ads using the latest AI tools.



Our goal is simple: create video ads that perform.



You'll be given winning ads from competitors and other industries and asked to recreate the underlying concepts using AI—not copy them, but understand why they work and build original ads inspired by those winning ideas.



If you're constantly experimenting with new AI models, staying ahead of the latest releases, and love figuring out how to make better ads than everyone else, we'd love to talk.



What You'll Do

Create high-performing video advertisements using AI tools from concept to final edit.

Analyze successful ads and recreate the concepts using original AI-generated content.

Rapidly test different hooks, angles, visuals, pacing, and calls-to-action.

Generate realistic AI video, voiceovers, imagery, avatars, and motion graphics.

Combine multiple AI tools into efficient production workflows.

Stay on the cutting edge of new AI creative tools and recommend better ways to produce ads.

Deliver multiple creative variations for testing rather than a single "finished" ad.

Work closely with our marketing team to iterate based on performance data.

You're Probably a Great Fit If...

You obsess over
, TikTok, YouTube, and Instagram ads.

You understand that the goal isn't making beautiful videos—it's making videos that convert.

You constantly experiment with new AI tools before everyone else.

You know which AI model is best for each part of the creative process.

You enjoy reverse-engineering winning ads and building your own versions.

You're comfortable moving quickly and producing lots of creative iterations.

AI Tools We Use (or Similar)



Experience with many of these is a huge plus:



Google Flow

Kling 3.0

Seedance 2.0

Higgsfield

Motion Control

Marketing Studio

Nano Banana Pro

ElevenLabs

GPT

HeyGen

CapCut

Canva

Kie.ai



You don't need experience with every tool, but you should be someone who is constantly learning new AI platforms and can quickly pick up emerging technology.



Qualifications

Strong portfolio of AI-generated video advertisements.

Experience creating performance marketing creatives, not just cinematic videos.

Understanding of what makes ads convert (hooks, retention, storytelling, pacing, CTAs).

Comfortable taking inspiration from existing ads while creating original content.

Excellent prompt engineering skills.

Strong editing skills.

Ability to work quickly and produce multiple creative concepts.

Bonus Points

Experience with direct-response marketing.

Experience running or optimizing paid social campaigns.

Understanding of Meta, TikTok, or YouTube ad creative best practices.

Graphic design or copywriting experience.

Familiarity with A/B testing creative.

To Apply



Please include:



Your portfolio.

3-5 AI-generated ads you're most proud of.

A list of the AI tools you use regularly.

Tell us about a recent AI tool or workflow you've discovered that significantly improved your creative process.

If selected, we'll ask you to complete a short paid creative test where you'll recreate the concept of an existing ad using AI.
